config.title: 并列连词 FANBOYS 用法速查

examples.en: For（因为）
examples.zh: It must be late, for the streets are empty.（一定是很晚了，因为街上空无一人。）
examples.analysis: for 表原因，语气比 because 弱，通常补充说明理由

examples.en: And（和/并且）
examples.zh: She studies hard, and she also volunteers regularly.（她努力学习，并且定期做志愿者。）
examples.analysis: 最常用的并列连词，表递进或并列

examples.en: Nor（也不）
examples.zh: He doesn't like coffee, nor does he drink tea.（他不喜欢咖啡，也不喝茶。）
examples.analysis: 否定延续，后接倒装（nor + 助动词 + 主语）

examples.en: But（但是）
examples.zh: The exam was difficult, but most students passed.（考试很难，但大多数学生通过了。）
examples.analysis: 表转折，前后意思相反

examples.en: Or（或者/否则）
examples.zh: You must study harder, or you will fail the course.（你必须更努力学习，否则会挂科。）
examples.analysis: 表选择或警告（否则）

examples.en: Yet（然而）
examples.zh: The task was simple, yet nobody completed it on time.（任务很简单，然而没有人按时完成。）
examples.analysis: 类似 but，但语气更强调意外感

examples.en: So（因此）
examples.zh: The weather was terrible, so we cancelled the trip.（天气很糟糕，所以我们取消了旅行。）
examples.analysis: 表因果（所以），因果关系比 for 更直接

config.title: 常见错误：逗号粘连与碎句

examples.en: ❌ 逗号粘连（Comma Splice）
examples.zh: The weather is nice today, we should go for a walk.
examples.analysis:
错误原因：两个独立分句之间只有逗号，没有连词。独立分句必须用连词或分号连接。
✓ 修正1：The weather is nice today, so we should go for a walk.（加连词 so）
✓ 修正2：The weather is nice today; we should go for a walk.（用分号）
✓ 修正3：Because the weather is nice today, we should go for a walk.（改为复合句）

examples.en: ❌ 碎句（Sentence Fragment）
examples.zh: Because she was very tired. She went to bed early.
examples.analysis:
错误原因：Because she was very tired 是从句，不能独立成句。
✓ 修正1：Because she was very tired, she went to bed early.（从句+主句合成一句）
✓ 修正2：She was very tired. She went to bed early.（去掉 because，变成两个简单句）

常见碎句类型：
  • 从句独立成句：Although he tried hard. (✗)
  • 介词短语独立成句：In the classroom. (✗)
  • -ing 开头无主语：Walking down the street. (✗)

config.title: 句子类型判断
config.stem: 句子 "He did not study for the exam, nor did he attend the review sessions." 是什么类型？
config.explanation: nor 是并列连词（FANBOYS 之一），连接两个独立分句：He did not study for the exam 和 did he attend the review sessions。两个分句地位对等，由并列连词 nor 连接，所以是并列句。注意 nor 后面的部分用了倒装（did he attend），这是 nor 的固定用法。

config.title: 错误识别
config.stem: 下列哪个句子存在逗号粘连（Comma Splice）错误？

options.text: She loves reading, and she writes every day.
The deadline is tomorrow, we must finish tonight.
Although it rained heavily, the game continued.
He worked late; therefore, he missed the bus.

config.explanation: B 中两个独立分句（The deadline is tomorrow / we must finish tonight）仅用逗号连接，缺少连词，这是典型的逗号粘连。修正：加 so（...tomorrow, so we must...）。A 有并列连词 and，正确。C 有从属连词 Although，正确。D 用了分号加 therefore，正确。

config.title: 连词选择与句子合并
config.stem:
用合适的连词合并以下句子，或判断句子类型：

1. She was exhausted. She kept working. → She was exhausted, {{1}} she kept working.
2. I want to travel abroad. I need to save money first. → I want to travel abroad, {{2}} I need to save money first.
3. The book was interesting. It was too long.（用让步从句合并）→ {{3}} the book was interesting, it was too long.
4. "He arrived late. Because the traffic was terrible."（指出错误类型）→ {{4}}
config.explanation: ① exhausted 与 kept working 是转折关系 → but/yet。② 想出国和需要存钱是因果关系 → so（因此需要存钱）。③ 让步从句用 although/though 引导，表示「虽然有趣但太长了」。④ Because the traffic was terrible 是原因状语从句，不能独立成句，这是碎句错误，应与主句合并为：He arrived late because the traffic was terrible.

config.title: 句子合并实战
config.source: The city is growing rapidly. The infrastructure cannot keep up. The government needs to invest more.
config.taskDescription: 用至少一个连词（并列或从属）将三个简单句合并为 1-2 个句子
reference: The city is growing rapidly, but the infrastructure cannot keep up, so the government needs to invest more.（并列连词 but + so）
Although the city is growing rapidly, the infrastructure cannot keep up, which means the government needs to invest more.（从属连词 although + 定语从句 which）
rubric: 使用了至少一个连词
逻辑关系正确（转折/因果/让步）
没有逗号粘连或碎句错误

config.text: 三种句子类型，两类连词——用连词搭建句子间的逻辑桥梁
takeaway: 简单句：一个主谓结构（She studies.）
并列句：FANBOYS 连接两个对等分句（She studies, but he plays.）
复合句：从属连词引导从句依附主句（She studies because the exam is coming.）
并列连词 FANBOYS：For / And / Nor / But / Or / Yet / So
从属连词：because / although / if / when / while / since / unless / until...
两大错误：逗号粘连（两独立分句只逗号无连词）和碎句（从句独立成句）

objectives: 掌握最常用的四种时态的核心用法与构成
能够根据时间标志词判断应使用的时态
理解每种时态的「核心语义」而非死记公式

config.text: 时态是英语动词的「时间标签」——选错时态就像在错误的时间出现，意思全变了。

config.rule: 时态 = 时间（现在/过去/将来）+ 体（一般/进行/完成/完成进行），本节掌握最核心的四种
config.formula: 选择时态的关键：看时间标志词 + 判断动作状态
bullets: 一般现在时：习惯/事实/真理 → always / often / usually / every day / on Mondays
一般过去时：过去已完成的动作 → yesterday / last week / in 2020 / two days ago
现在进行时：此刻正在发生 → now / right now / at the moment / look! / listen!
现在完成时：过去发生的动作对现在有影响 → already / yet / just / ever / never / since / for / recently / so far

examples.en: 一般现在时：主语 + 动词原形（三单加-s）
examples.zh: She walks to school every day.

steps.label: 构成
steps.detail: 主语 + V/V-s（三单加-s/es）

steps.label: 核心语义
steps.detail: ① 习惯性动作 ② 客观事实/真理 ③ 按计划将要发生的事

steps.label: 例句
steps.detail: The earth revolves around the sun.（真理）/ The train leaves at 8 tomorrow.（计划）

examples.en: 一般过去时：主语 + 动词过去式
examples.zh: He graduated from college last year.

steps.label: 构成
steps.detail: 主语 + V-ed（不规则需单独记）

steps.label: 核心语义
steps.detail: 过去某个时间完成的动作，与现在无关

steps.label: 例句
steps.detail: I lived in Shanghai in 2019.（现在不一定住那了）

examples.en: 现在进行时：主语 + am/is/are + V-ing
examples.zh: They are discussing the project right now.

steps.label: 构成
steps.detail: 主语 + be + V-ing

steps.label: 核心语义
steps.detail: ① 此刻正在做 ② 近期持续的趋势 ③ 表将来（已安排）

steps.label: 例句
steps.detail: She is always losing her keys.（抱怨，always+进行表情绪）/ We are leaving tomorrow.（表将来安排）

examples.en: 现在完成时：主语 + have/has + V-ed（过去分词）
examples.zh: I have already finished my homework.

steps.label: 构成
steps.detail: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词

steps.label: 核心语义
steps.detail: ① 过去做某事，结果影响现在 ② 从过去持续到现在的状态/动作

steps.label: 例句
steps.detail: She has lived here since 2010.（2010年至今一直住这）/ I have lost my key.（钥匙丢了→现在还找不到）

config.title: 一般过去时 vs 现在完成时——最易混淆的对比

examples.en: I lost my key yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把钥匙丢了。
examples.analysis: 一般过去时：强调动作发生在过去（yesterday），不关心现在是否找到

examples.en: I have lost my key.
examples.zh: 我把钥匙丢了。
examples.analysis: 现在完成时：强调结果对现在的影响——钥匙现在还找不到，我被锁在外面了

examples.en: 核心区分方法
examples.zh: 问自己：是否关心「现在怎样」？
examples.analysis:
• 只陈述过去事实 → 一般过去时
  I visited Paris in 2019.（2019去了巴黎，现在怎么样不重要）

• 强调对现在的影响 → 现在完成时
  I have visited Paris.（我去过巴黎→现在我知道巴黎什么样/不需要再去第一次）

• 时间标志词区分：
  过去时：yesterday / last week / in 2020 / two days ago（明确的过去时间点）
  完成时：already / yet / just / ever / never / since / for / recently / so far（与现在相连的时间段）

config.title: 时态选择练习 1
config.stem: "So far this semester, the student _____ three essays." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: So far（到目前为止）是现在完成时的标志词，表示从学期开始到现在这个时间段内已经写了3篇论文，强调结果对现在有影响（已经完成了3篇）。A 一般现在时不合适（没有习惯性动作的语境）；B 一般过去时暗示动作与现在无关，但 so far 明确与现在相连；D 现在进行时表示正在写，与 three essays 已完成的语境矛盾。

config.title: 时态选择练习 2
config.stem: 下列哪个句子中，现在进行时表「近期持续趋势」？

options.text: Look! The children are playing in the garden.
The population of the city is growing rapidly.
We are meeting the client at 3 PM tomorrow.
She is always forgetting her phone.

config.explanation: A 表此刻正在做（Look! 提示此刻）；B 表近期持续趋势——城市人口增长不是某一刻的事，是持续的趋势；C 表将来安排（are meeting = will meet，已安排的见面）；D 表抱怨（always + 进行时表反复行为和不满情绪）。

config.title: 时态填空
config.stem:
根据语境选择合适的时态，填入动词的正确形式：

1. She {{1}} (go) to the gym three times a week.
2. I {{2}} (not/see) him since he moved to Beijing.
3. Look! Someone {{3}} (knock) at the door.
4. They {{4}} (build) this bridge in 2018.
5. We {{5}} (already/submit) the report, so we can relax now.
config.explanation: ① three times a week = 习惯 → 一般现在时，主语 she → goes。② since + 过去时间点 → 现在完成时 → haven't seen。③ Look! = 此刻 → 现在进行时 → is knocking。④ in 2018 = 明确的过去时间 → 一般过去时 → built。⑤ already + 对现在有影响（可以放松了）→ 现在完成时 → have already submitted。

config.text: 四种时态，四种时间感——别死记公式，问自己：动作什么时候发生的？现在还受影响吗？
takeaway: 一般现在时：习惯/事实 → always / every day / V-s
一般过去时：过去已完成 → yesterday / last / V-ed
现在进行时：正在做/趋势 → now / be + V-ing
现在完成时：过去影响现在 → already / since / have + V-ed
关键区分：一般过去 vs 现在完成 = 是否关心「现在怎样」

objectives: 了解英语12种时态的全貌（4时间×3体）
掌握CET考试中高频出现的6-8种时态
能够辨析易混时态的细微差别

config.text: 12种时态听起来很多，但其实只有4个时间×3个体——掌握了矩阵，时态不再混乱。

config.rule: 12种时态 = 4个时间（现在/过去/将来/过去将来）× 3个体（一般/进行/完成/完成进行）
config.formula: 时态 = 时间轴位置 + 动作状态
bullets: 一般体：关注事实本身，不强调过程或结果
进行体：关注动作正在进行的「过程」
完成体：关注动作的「结果/影响」
完成进行体：关注「一直持续到现在」的过程
CET 高频8种：一般现在/过去/将来、现在/过去进行、现在/过去完成、现在完成进行
CET 低频4种：过去将来/过去将来进行/过去将来完成/过去将来完成进行（主要出现在虚拟语气和间接引语中）

config.title: 12种时态矩阵（以 work 为例）

examples.en: 时态矩阵速查
examples.zh: 按时间和体排列，粗体为CET高频
examples.analysis:
一般              进行                完成                 完成进行
现在  **works**         **is working**      **has worked**       **has been working**
过去  **worked**        **was working**     **had worked**       had been working
将来  **will work**     will be working     will have worked    will have been working
过去将来 would work     would be working   would have worked   would have been working

构成规律：
• 一般：V / V-ed / will V / would V
• 进行：be + V-ing（随时间变be）
• 完成：have + V-ed（随时间变have）
• 完成进行：have been + V-ing（随时间变have）

config.title: 易混时态对比一：过去完成时 vs 一般过去时

examples.en: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
examples.zh: 我到达时，会议已经开始了。

steps.label: had started
steps.detail: 过去完成时：会议开始在我到达之前——「过去的过去」

steps.label: arrived
steps.detail: 一般过去时：作为参照时间点

steps.label: 核心规则
steps.detail: 过去完成时 = 过去的过去，必须有一个过去的参照时间

examples.en: I arrived at 9 AM. The meeting started at 8:30.
examples.zh: 我9点到的。会议8:30开始的。
examples.analysis:
两个都是一般过去时——只陈述各自发生的时间，不强调先后关系。

⚠️ 过去完成时不能单独使用：
❌ I had finished my homework.（没有参照时间，不完整）
✓ I had finished my homework before dinner.（before dinner 是参照时间）

config.title: 易混时态对比二：现在完成进行时 vs 现在完成时

examples.en: I have been waiting for two hours.
examples.zh: 我一直等了两个小时。（还在等/强调过程漫长）

steps.label: have been waiting
steps.detail: 强调从过去到现在一直在等，而且可能继续等下去

steps.label: 语气
steps.detail: 暗含不满/不耐烦——强调持续了多久

examples.en: I have waited for two hours.
examples.zh: 我已经等了两个小时。（陈述事实/关注结果）

steps.label: have waited
steps.detail: 强调等待这个动作的结果/事实——等了2小时

steps.label: 语气
steps.detail: 中性陈述，不带情绪色彩

examples.en: 关键区分
examples.zh: 完成进行 = 强调过程的持续性（可能还在继续）；完成 = 强调结果
examples.analysis:
• She has been learning English for 5 years.（还在学，强调持续过程）
• She has learned 3000 English words.（学到了3000个，强调结果/数量）

⚠️ 注意：不是所有动词都能用进行时！
静态动词（know / believe / own / belong / seem / love / hate）一般不用进行时：
❌ I am knowing the answer. ✗ → I know the answer. ✓

config.title: 时态选择练习 1
config.stem: "By the time we got to the station, the train _____." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: By the time we got to the station 表示「等我们到车站的时候」，got 是过去的参照时间；火车开走发生在这之前，是「过去的过去」→ 过去完成时 had left。A 一般过去时无法表达先后关系；B 现在完成时与过去语境不匹配；D 过去进行时表示正在离开，与语境不符。

config.title: 时态选择练习 2
config.stem: "She is exhausted because she _____ all morning." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: is exhausted 是现在的状态，原因是「整个上午一直在工作」→ 现在完成进行时 has been working，强调过程的持续性和现在仍在进行/刚结束。B has worked 也可以语法成立，但不如 has been working 能体现「一直持续」导致疲惫的因果逻辑。A 一般现在时不合适；D 一般过去时与 all morning 不搭配（缺少对现在的影响）。

config.title: 时态辨析填空
config.stem:
选择合适的时态形式填空：

1. By the end of last month, she {{1}} (complete) all the required courses.
2. I {{2}} (know) him for ten years. We are still good friends.（用现在完成时还是完成进行时？）
3. He {{3}} (live) in London since 2015, and he still lives there now.
4. The rain {{4}} (stop) before we stepped out of the house.
5. She {{5}} (study) German for three years, but she still can't speak it fluently.

blanks.hint: by the end of last month → 过去的过去
know是静态动词，不用进行时
since 2015 + still → 现在完成(进行)时
before we stepped → 过去的过去
for three years + but still → 强调持续

config.explanation: ① By the end of last month 是过去的参照时间 → 过去完成时 had completed。② know 是静态动词，不用进行时 → have known（不用 have been knowing）。③ since 2015 + still → 现在完成时 has lived 或现在完成进行时 has been living 都可以。④ 雨停在我们出门之前 → 过去的过去 → had stopped。⑤ for three years + but still can't → 强调一直持续学但效果不佳 → has been studying 更合适。

config.text: 12种时态的本质：4个时间 × 3个体——掌握矩阵，不要死记
takeaway: 一般体：关注事实 → V / V-ed / will V
进行体：关注过程 → be + V-ing
完成体：关注结果 → have + V-ed
完成进行体：关注持续 → have been + V-ing
过去完成时 = 过去的过去，必须有参照时间
现在完成进行时强调持续过程，现在完成时强调结果
静态动词（know/believe/love/own）一般不用进行时

objectives: 掌握主动→被动语态的转换规则
了解各时态的被动形式
明确何时该用被动语态，何时不该用

config.text: 主动语态强调「谁做的」，被动语态强调「被怎么样了」——学术论文和新闻中，被动语态是常态。

config.rule: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词（done），be 随时态和主语变化
config.formula: 主动 S + V + O → 被动 O + be + done + (by S)
bullets: 转换步骤：① 宾语变主语 ② 谓语变 be + done ③ 原主语变 by 短语（可省略）
核心：be 的时态与原句谓语时态一致，done 永远是过去分词不变

常用时态的被动形式：
  一般现在：is/am/are done
  一般过去：was/were done
  现在进行：is/am/are being done
  过去进行：was/were being done
  现在完成：has/have been done
  过去完成：had been done
  一般将来：will be done
  含情态动词：can/must/should be done
by 短语省略原则：不需要/不知道执行者时省略

examples.en: 一般现在时
examples.zh: 主动：Many people speak English. → 被动：English is spoken by many people.

steps.label: 宾语→主语
steps.detail: English 变为主语

steps.label: speak→is spoken
steps.detail: 一般现在时被动：is + spoken

steps.label: by + 原主语
steps.detail: by many people（可省略）

examples.en: 现在完成时
examples.zh: 主动：They have published the results. → 被动：The results have been published.

steps.label: 宾语→主语
steps.detail: the results 变为主语

steps.label: have published→have been published
steps.detail: 现在完成时被动：have been + published

steps.label: by they省略
steps.detail: they 是泛指，不需要保留

examples.en: 含情态动词
examples.zh: 主动：We must complete the task today. → 被动：The task must be completed today.

steps.label: 宾语→主语
steps.detail: the task 变为主语

steps.label: must complete→must be completed
steps.detail: 情态动词被动：情态动词 + be + done

examples.en: ① 不知道/不需要说出执行者
examples.zh: The window was broken during the night.（窗户在夜间被打破了。）
examples.analysis: 谁打破的不知道，也不重要——重点是窗户破了

examples.en: ② 强调动作承受者
examples.zh: The new policy was announced yesterday.（新政策昨天公布了。）
examples.analysis: 关注的是政策（承受者），而非谁来公布的

examples.en: ③ 学术/正式写作惯例
examples.zh: The experiment was conducted in a controlled environment.（实验在受控环境中进行。）
examples.analysis: 学术写作常用被动，避免主观性，突出研究对象和过程

examples.en: ④ 翻译中的中文无主语句
examples.zh: 据说…… → It is said that... / 大家都知道…… → It is well known that...
examples.analysis: 中文常省略主语，英文用 It is + done 结构对应

examples.en: ❌ 不及物动词没有被动
examples.zh: The accident happened last night.（不能说 The accident was happened.）
examples.analysis: happen / occur / appear / disappear / belong / exist 等不及物动词无被动——没有宾语，无从转换

examples.en: ❌ 系动词没有被动
examples.zh: The flower smells sweet.（不能说 The flower is smelled sweet.）
examples.analysis: be / seem / look / feel / taste / sound / become 等系动词后接表语，不是宾语，不能变被动

examples.en: ❌ 某些固定搭配用主动表被动含义
examples.zh: The book sells well. / The cloth washes easily. / The door won't open.
examples.analysis:
sell / wash / wear / open / read 等动词在描述事物属性时，用主动形式表被动含义
→ 这不是语法错误，而是英语的习惯表达

config.title: 被动语态形式判断
config.stem: 句子 "A new hospital is being built in our neighborhood." 使用的是哪种时态的被动语态？
config.explanation: is being built = be(is) + being + done(built)，这是现在进行时的被动形式（am/is/are being done），表示医院「正在被建造」。A 一般现在时被动应为 is built；C 现在完成时被动应为 has been built；D 一般将来时被动应为 will be built。

config.title: 主动转被动
config.stem: 将 "Someone had stolen the painting before the museum opened." 改为被动语态，正确的是？

options.text: The painting had stolen before the museum opened.
The painting had been stolen before the museum opened.
The painting has been stolen before the museum opened.
The painting was stolen before the museum had opened.

config.explanation: 原句谓语是过去完成时 had stolen → 被动形式 had been stolen。A 缺少 been（had stolen 变成了主动语态）；C 用了现在完成时 has been，与原句时态不一致；D 把两个动词的时态搞反了。关键：被动语态中 done 不变，只有 be 随时态变化。

config.title: 被动语态填空
config.stem:
用动词的正确被动形式填空：

1. English {{1}} (speak) in many countries around the world.
2. The new library {{2}} (complete) by the end of next year.
3. The problem {{3}} (discuss) when I entered the meeting room.
4. All the tickets {{4}} (sell) out before the concert began.
5. The report must {{5}} (submit) by Friday.

blanks.hint: by the end of next year → 将来
when I entered → 过去进行时被动
before the concert began → 过去完成时被动

config.explanation: ① 一般现在时被动：is spoken（事实）。② by the end of next year → 将来时被动：will be completed（或将来完成被动 will have been completed）。③ when I entered → 正在被讨论（过去进行时被动）：was being discussed。④ before the concert began → 之前已售完（过去完成时被动）：had been sold out。⑤ 情态动词被动：must be submitted（must + be + done）。

config.text: 被动 = be + done，be 随时态变化，done 永远不变——用被动是为了强调承受者，而非隐藏执行者
takeaway: 核心公式：be + done（be变时态，done不变）
转换步骤：宾语→主语 / 谓语→be+done / 主语→by短语
用时：不知道执行者 / 强调承受者 / 学术写作 / 中文无主语
不用：不及物动词 / 系动词 / 主动表被动(sells well)
高频固定被动：It is said that / It is well known that / It is reported that

objectives: 理解时态一致性的原则与例外
掌握叙事文中时态的切换规则
了解间接引语中的时态后退现象
在完形填空中利用时态线索词解题

config.text: 写作时态随便跳，阅卷老师一眼看出——时态一致性是写作中最容易扣分也最好避免的问题。

stat.label: 学生写作时态不一致率

config.rule: 同一语境下，时态应保持一致；切换时态必须有明确的时间信号
config.formula: 时态一致 = 同一语境同一时态，切换要有理由
bullets: 基本规则：同一个段落/同一个语境中，时态不能无故切换
叙事文默认用一般过去时，对话/直接引语用对话所需的时态
间接引语中，主句过去时 → 从句时态后退一步（时态呼应）
客观事实/真理永远用一般现在时，不受主句时态影响
完形填空解题：先找时态线索词（时间状语/上下文动词时态），再确定空格时态

examples.en: ✓ 正确示范（叙事文统一用一般过去时）
examples.zh: Last summer, I traveled to Yunnan. The scenery was breathtaking, and the local food was delicious. I met many friendly people there.

steps.label: 时间设定
steps.detail: Last summer 确立了过去时的语境

steps.label: 统一过去时
steps.detail: traveled / was / was / met 全部一般过去时

steps.label: 评价
steps.detail: 时态一致，阅读流畅

examples.en: ❌ 错误示范（时态无理由跳转）
examples.zh: Last summer, I traveled to Yunnan. The scenery is breathtaking, and the local food was delicious. I meet many friendly people there.
examples.analysis:
❌ is → 应为 was（同一叙事语境中不应跳到一般现在时）
❌ meet → 应为 met（过去的事）

⚠️ 如果确实需要切换时态，必须有明确理由：
✓ The scenery was breathtaking — in fact, it still is today.（用 still is today 提供了切换到现在的理由）

config.title: 间接引语中的时态后退

examples.en: 时态后退规则
examples.zh: 主句过去时 → 从句时态往回退一步
examples.analysis:
直接引语 → 间接引语（主句动词为过去时）：

一般现在 → 一般过去
  "I like coffee." → He said he liked coffee.

现在进行 → 过去进行
  "I am studying." → She said she was studying.

现在完成 → 过去完成
  "I have finished." → He said he had finished.

一般过去 → 过去完成
  "I went there." → She said she had gone there.

一般将来 → 过去将来
  "I will come." → He said he would come.

⚠️ 不后退的例外：
① 客观真理不变：He said the earth revolves around the sun.（真理用一般现在时）
② 时间状语变化："I graduated last year." → She said she graduated last year.（last year 没变，不需要后退）

config.title: 完形填空中的时态线索词识别

examples.en: 解题策略
examples.zh: 先找时态线索，再填动词形式
examples.analysis:
步骤：
1. 找空格附近的「时间标志词」
2. 找同句/相邻句中已给出的动词时态
3. 根据语境判断时态，再填空

常见线索词：
• 一般过去：yesterday / last / ago / in + 过去年份 / then
• 现在完成：already / yet / just / since / for / recently / so far / up to now
• 过去完成：by the time / before / after / by the end of + 过去时间
• 进行时：now / at that time / when I arrived

真题示例思路：
"By the time the police arrived, the thief ___ away."
→ 线索：by the time + arrived（过去时）
→ 判断：小偷跑了发生在警察到达之前 → 过去的过去
→ 答案：had run

config.title: 时态一致性判断
config.stem: 下列哪个句子时态不一致？

options.text: She said she would come to the party, but she didn't show up.
He told me that he has finished the report yesterday.
The teacher explained that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
I realized that I had left my phone at home.

config.explanation: B 错在时态不一致：主句 told 是过去时，从句应时态后退 → has finished 应改为 had finished；且 yesterday 搭配一般过去时/过去完成时，不搭配现在完成时。A 中 would come（过去将来）+ didn't show up（一般过去）一致。C 中 boils 是客观真理，不受主句过去时影响，正确。D 中 had left（过去完成）在 realized（一般过去）之后，时态后退正确。

config.title: 时态一致性填空
config.stem:
根据时态一致性原则填入正确形式：

1. She said she {{1}} (be) too busy to attend the meeting.
2. Galileo proved that the earth {{2}} (revolve) around the sun.
3. Last night, I {{3}} (watch) TV when the power suddenly {{4}} (go) out.
4. He {{5}} (already/finish) his homework before his mother came home.

blanks.hint: last night + when → 过去进行时
before came home → 过去的过去

config.explanation: ① said 是过去时，从句时态后退：am → was。② 客观真理不后退，仍用一般现在时 revolves。③ Last night 确立过去语境，「正在看电视时突然停电」→ was watching + went（过去进行+一般过去，表中断）。④ 在妈妈回来之前已完成 → 过去完成时 had already finished。

config.text: 时态一致性 = 同一语境不乱跳，切换必须有理由——这是写作最容易改好的问题
takeaway: 叙事文统一用一般过去时，不无故跳到现在时
间接引语：主句过去时 → 从句时态后退一步
客观真理永远一般现在时，不受主句时态影响
完形填空：先找时间线索词和上下文动词时态
写作检查：写完后通读一遍，专门查时态是否一致

objectives: 掌握主谓一致三大原则
识别CET完形填空中高频的主谓一致考点
避免写作中最常见的主谓不一致错误

config.text: 主语和谓语就像舞伴——单数配单数，复数配复数。但英语有些「伪装者」，看着像复数其实是单数，看着像单数其实是复数。

config.rule: 主谓一致三条原则：语法一致（看形式）、意义一致（看含义）、就近原则（看最近）
config.formula: 主语单数 → 谓语单数；主语复数 → 谓语复数
bullets: 语法一致：主语形式是单数→谓语单数，主语形式是复数→谓语复数（最基本）
意义一致：主语形式和含义不一致时，按含义选谓语（如 family 看整体→单数，看成员→复数）
就近原则：谓语与最近的主语保持一致（either...or / neither...nor / not only...but also）

examples.en: My family is large. / My family are all doctors.
examples.zh: 我的家庭很大。/ 我的家人都是医生。
examples.analysis:
family 看作一个整体（家庭）→ 单数 is
family 看作各个成员（家人们）→ 复数 are

常见集合名词：family / class / team / group / audience / committee / government / public

判断方法：强调「一个整体」→ 单数；强调「每个成员」→ 复数
  The committee has made its decision.（委员会作为一个整体做出了决定）
  The committee are divided in their opinions.（委员们意见分歧）

examples.en: police / people / cattle 永远复数
examples.zh: The police are investigating the case. / Many people have applied for the job.
examples.analysis:
police / people / cattle 形式是单数，但含义是复数，谓语永远用复数
❌ The police is coming. ✗ → The police are coming. ✓

examples.en: Either you or he is wrong.
examples.zh: 要么你要么他错了。
examples.analysis:
either...or / neither...nor / not only...but also → 谓语与最近的主语一致
最近的主语是 he（单数）→ is wrong
如果是 Either he or you are wrong. → 最近主语是 you → are wrong

examples.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was invited.
examples.zh: 不仅学生，老师也被邀请了。
examples.analysis:
最近的主语是 the teacher（单数）→ was invited
如果是 Not only the teacher but also the students were invited. → 最近主语 the students → were invited

config.title: 高频错点三：插入语干扰与特殊结构

examples.en: The teacher, together with his students, was present at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 老师和他的学生一起出席了典礼。
examples.analysis:
主语是 the teacher（单数），together with his students 是插入语，不影响主谓一致

类似结构（不算并列主语，不影响谓语）：
with / together with / along with / as well as / besides / in addition to / including / rather than

⚠️ 区别于 and：
  The teacher and his students were present.（and 连接并列主语 → 复数 were）
  The teacher, together with his students, was present.（together with 不算并列 → 单数 was）

examples.en: a number of vs the number of
examples.zh: A number of students have applied. / The number of applicants has increased.
examples.analysis:
a number of + 复数名词 + 复数谓语（a number of = many，修饰主语 students）
the number of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语（the number of 是主语核心词 number）

记忆：a number of → 许多（复数概念）；the number of → ……的数量（单数概念）

examples.en: 时间/金钱/距离作主语
examples.zh: Ten miles is a long distance. / Five thousand dollars is a reasonable price.
examples.analysis:
表示时间、金钱、距离、重量的复数名词作主语 → 看作一个整体 → 单数谓语
Ten miles = 一段距离（整体）→ is
Five thousand dollars = 一笔钱（整体）→ is

config.title: 主谓一致练习 1
config.stem: 句子 "The number of international students in our university _____ increased significantly." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: the number of 是主语核心词（number），意为「……的数量」，是单数概念 → has increased。对比：A number of international students have applied.（a number of = many，主语是 students → 复数谓语 have）。

config.title: 主谓一致练习 2
config.stem: 下列哪个句子主谓不一致？

options.text: Each of the students has submitted the assignment.
Neither the teacher nor the students was informed about the change.
Three weeks is enough time to complete the project.
The committee are still discussing the proposal.

config.explanation: B 错误：neither...nor 就近原则，最近的主语是 the students（复数）→ 应为 were informed。A 正确：each of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语。C 正确：时间量作主语看作整体 → 单数。D 正确：committee 看作各成员在讨论 → 复数 are（意义一致）。

config.title: 主谓一致填空
config.stem:
填入正确的谓语形式：

1. The audience {{1}} (be) enjoying the performance.
2. Everyone in the class {{2}} (have) passed the exam.
3. Neither the manager nor the employees {{3}} (know) about the decision.
4. The professor, along with his assistants, {{4}} (be) attending the conference.
5. A number of problems {{5}} (have) been identified in the system.
config.explanation: ① audience 看作各成员在欣赏表演 → are。② everyone + 单数谓语 → has。③ neither...nor 就近原则，最近主语 employees（复数）→ know。④ along with 不算并列主语，主语是 the professor（单数）→ is。⑤ a number of = many，主语是 problems → have。

config.text: 主谓一致三原则——语法一致看形式，意义一致看含义，就近原则看最近
takeaway: 集合名词：看整体→单数，看成员→复数（family/team/class）
就近原则：either...or / neither...nor / not only...but also → 看最近的
插入语不算：with / together with / as well as / besides → 不影响谓语
a number of = many(复数) / the number of = 数量(单数)
时间/金钱/距离 → 看整体 → 单数
everyone / each / nobody / everything → 永远单数

objectives: 掌握常见情态动词的基本含义与用法区别
理解情态动词+have done的推测体系
区分「推测用法」与「虚拟用法」（should have done 的两种解读）

config.text: 情态动词是英语的「语气词」——同一个动词，加上不同的情态动词，意思可能完全相反。

config.rule: 情态动词表达说话人的态度：能力/许可/义务/推测
config.formula: 情态动词 + 动词原形（基础用法）/ 情态动词 + have + done（推测/虚拟）
bullets: can：能力/许可 — I can swim. / Can I go now?
could：过去能力 / 委婉请求 / 推测(比may弱) — Could you help me?
may：许可 / 推测(可能) — May I come in? / It may rain tomorrow.
might：更弱的推测 — She might be at home. (比may可能性更低)
must：必须 / 强推测(一定) — You must finish it. / He must be tired.
should：应该/建议 — You should review before the exam.
would：意愿/假设/委婉 — Would you like some tea?
ought to：应该(比should正式) — You ought to apologize.
⚠️ 情态动词无人称变化(无三单-s)，后接动词原形

examples.en: can vs may vs must（许可强度递增）
examples.zh: Can I use your phone?（随意）/ May I use your phone?（正式）/ You must submit the form by Friday.（强制）
examples.analysis:
许可：can（随意/口语）< may（正式/礼貌）< must（强制/义务）

⚠️ can't vs mustn't：
  can't = 不可以（口语）= may not
  mustn't = 禁止（强烈）
  You mustn't smoke here. = 这里禁止吸烟。

examples.en: may vs might vs could（推测可能性递减）
examples.zh: She may be right.（有可能）/ She might be right.（也许，可能性更低）/ That could be true.（有可能）
examples.analysis:
推测强度：must(90%) > should(80%) > may(50%) > might/could(30%)

must + 动词原形 = 「一定」做了某事（肯定推测）
  He must be a doctor.（他一定是医生）

can't + 动词原形 = 「不可能」做了某事（否定推测）
  He can't be a doctor.（他不可能是医生）

⚠️ 否定推测用 can't，不用 mustn't：
  ❌ He mustn't be a doctor. ✗ → He can't be a doctor. ✓

config.title: 情态动词 + have done 推测体系（CET高频）

examples.en: must have done — 肯定推测（一定做了）
examples.zh: The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.
examples.analysis: 地面湿了→昨晚一定下雨了。对过去事实的肯定推断。

examples.en: can't have done — 否定推测（不可能做了）
examples.zh: She can't have finished the report already. She just started an hour ago.
examples.analysis:
一小时前才开始→不可能已经完成了。对过去事实的否定推断。
⚠️ 否定推测用 can't have done，不用 mustn't have done。

examples.en: may/might/could have done — 可能推测（可能做了）
examples.zh: He may have left the office early. / She might have missed the train.
examples.analysis: 对过去事实的可能性推断——不确定，只是猜测。

examples.en: should have done — 本该做（没做，含责备）
examples.zh: You should have told me earlier.（你本该早点告诉我。——实际没告诉）
examples.analysis:
⚠️ should have done 有两种解读：
① 推测：应该已经做了（They should have arrived by now. 他们现在应该已经到了。）
② 责备/遗憾：本该做但没做（You should have studied harder. 你本该更努力学习的。）

区分方法：看语境——如果是评价他人的行为，通常是责备语气。

examples.en: needn't have done — 不必做却做了
examples.zh: You needn't have brought an umbrella. It's not going to rain.（你本不必带伞的。——但实际带了）
examples.analysis:
对比：didn't need to do = 不需要做（可能也没做）
  I didn't need to get up early yesterday. = 昨天不需要早起（实际也没早起）
  I needn't have got up early yesterday. = 昨天本不必早起（实际早起了，白起了）

examples.en: could have done — 本可以做（没做，含遗憾）
examples.zh: I could have passed the exam if I had studied harder.（如果更努力学习，我本可以考过的。）
examples.analysis: 与虚拟语气交叉——本节只讲其推测含义，虚拟用法见6-3。

config.title: 情态动词辨义练习
config.stem: 句子 "The lights are on, so someone _____ be at home." 横线处最合适的是？
config.explanation: 灯亮着→有人在家是高度确定的推断→ must be（肯定推测「一定」）。A can 表能力或许可，不表推测；C should 表应该，推测强度不如 must；D need 不表推测。推测语境中：must = 一定，should = 应该（80%把握），may/might = 可能。

config.title: 情态动词+have done 练习
config.stem: 句子 "You _____ the door unlocked. Anything could have happened!" 横线处应填？（含责备语气）
config.explanation: 语境含责备（不该做却做了）→ shouldn't have left（本不该把门开着）。B mustn't leave 是现在/将来的禁止，不是对过去行为的责备。C needn't have left = 不必做却做了，与语境矛盾（门不该开着，不是不必开着）。D couldn't leave = 不能离开，语义不符。

config.title: 情态动词填空
config.stem:
根据语境选择合适的情态动词填空：

1. She {{1}} (推测：一定) be exhausted after working for 12 hours straight.
2. The score was 3-0. They {{2}} (责备：本该) practiced more before the match.
3. I {{3}} (不必做却做了) brought my laptop. There are computers available here.
4. He {{4}} (否定推测：不可能) have stolen the money. He was with me the whole time.
5. The meeting was cancelled. You {{5}} (不必：也没做) come after all.
config.explanation: ① 肯定推测 → must（12小时后一定筋疲力尽）。② 责备本该做没做 → should have（本该多练习）。③ 不必做却做了 → needn't have（白带了电脑，这里有电脑）。④ 否定推测 → can't have（不可能偷了钱，和我在一起）。⑤ 不需要做且没做 → didn't need to（会议取消了，你不需要来——实际也没来）。

config.text: 情态动词三层：基础含义→推测体系→虚拟色彩——have done 是关键分水岭
takeaway: 基础用法：can(能力/许可) / may(许可/推测) / must(必须/强推测) / should(应该)
推测强度：must(90%) > should(80%) > may(50%) > might/could(30%)
推测过去：must have done(一定做了) / can't have done(不可能做了) / may have done(可能做了)
责备/遗憾：should have done(本该做没做) / shouldn't have done(本不该做却做了)
不必：needn't have done(不必做却做了) vs didn't need to do(不必做也没做)
否定推测用 can't，不用 mustn't！
⚠️ should+动词原形(建议/命令)属于虚拟语气体系，见6-3/6-4

objectives: 掌握四种名词性从句的结构与功能（主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句、同位语从句）
熟练运用 that / whether / if / wh- 词引导名词性从句
辨析 that 引导名词性从句与定语从句的区别
掌握 it 作形式主语/形式宾语替代名词性从句

config.text: 一个句子嵌进另一个句子当「名词」用——这就是名词性从句。CET 阅读长难句中，超过 60% 都包含名词性从句。

stat.label: CET长难句含名词性从句的比例

config.rule: 名词性从句 = 一个完整的句子充当名词成分（主语/宾语/表语/同位语）
config.formula: 引导词 + 主语 + 谓语 = 名词性从句
bullets: 主语从句：That the earth is round is a fact.（that从句作主语）
宾语从句：I know that she is right.（that从句作宾语）
表语从句：The truth is that we need more time.（that从句作表语）
同位语从句：The fact that he survived is amazing.（that从句解释fact的内容）
引导词分类：①that（只起连接作用，不充当成分）②whether/if（是否）③wh-词（who/what/which/when/where/why/how，既连接又充当成分）
核心原则：名词性从句本身必须是完整的句子（主+谓齐全），引导词只负责「连接」和（有时）「充当成分」

examples.en: What he said surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他所说的话让所有人惊讶。
examples.analysis:
→ 主语从句：what he said 作整个句子的主语
   主句谓语：surprised / 主句宾语：everyone
   what 在从句中作 said 的宾语

examples.en: I cannot understand why she left so early.
examples.zh: 我无法理解她为什么那么早离开。
examples.analysis:
→ 宾语从句：why she left so early 作 understand 的宾语
   why 在从句中作原因状语

examples.en: The question is whether we should continue the project.
examples.zh: 问题是我们是否应该继续这个项目。
examples.analysis:
→ 表语从句：whether we should continue the project 作 is 的表语
   whether 在从句中只起连接作用（不充当成分）

examples.en: The news that our team won the championship spread quickly.
examples.zh: 我们队赢得冠军的消息迅速传开了。
examples.analysis:
→ 同位语从句：that our team won the championship 解释 news 的具体内容
   that 只起连接作用，在从句中不充当任何成分

config.rule: that 在名词性从句中只起连接作用，不充当任何成分，一般不可省略（宾语从句除外）
config.formula: that 从句作宾语时可省略；作主语/表语/同位语时不可省略
bullets: 宾语从句：I think (that) you are right. — 口语中 that 常省略
主语从句：That she passed the exam is certain. — that 不可省略
表语从句：The reason is that we lack funding. — that 不可省略
同位语从句：The belief that hard work pays off is common. — that 不可省略
whether vs if：whether 可引导所有四种名词性从句；if 只能引导宾语从句
whether/if 不可省略：I wonder whether/if he will come.（两者都行） / Whether he will come is uncertain.（只能用whether，不能if）

config.title: that 引导名词性从句 vs that 引导定语从句

examples.en: The news that he won the prize made us happy.
examples.zh: 他获奖的消息让我们高兴。
examples.analysis: → 同位语从句：that 只起连接作用，从句本身完整（he won the prize），解释 news 的内容

examples.en: The news that he told us made us happy.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们的那个消息让我们高兴。
examples.analysis: → 定语从句：that 作 told 的宾语（told us that=the news），从句不完整（缺宾语），修饰 news

examples.en: 判断口诀：看从句是否完整
examples.zh:
从句完整（主+谓齐全）→ that 无成分→ 名词性从句
从句不完整（缺主语/宾语）→ that 充当成分→ 定语从句

config.rule: it 作形式主语/形式宾语，替代过长的名词性从句，避免头重脚轻
config.formula: It + 谓语 + ... + that/whether/wh- 从句
bullets: 形式主语：It is well-known that the earth revolves around the sun.（= That the earth revolves around the sun is well-known.）
形式主语常见句型：It is + adj. + that... / It is said that... / It happens that...
形式宾语：I find it difficult that he should refuse the offer.（it 替代 that 从句作 find 的宾语）
形式宾语结构：主语 + 谓语 + it + 宾补 + that/whether 从句
判断方法：句首的 it 后面紧跟 is/was/seems 等且没有明确指代物→大概率是形式主语

config.stem: 下列哪个句子中的 that 引导的是定语从句（而非名词性从句）？

options.text: It is obvious that he is lying.
The fact that she resigned shocked everyone.
The book that you lent me was fascinating.
I believe that we can solve this problem.

config.explanation: C 中 that you lent me 是定语从句：从句缺宾语（lent 缺宾语，that 充当 lent 的宾语），修饰 book。A 是主语从句（it 形式主语，that 从句完整）；B 是同位语从句（she resigned 完整，that 只连接）；D 是宾语从句（we can solve this problem 完整，that 只连接）。关键判断：从句完整→名词性从句；从句缺成分→定语从句。

config.stem: 填入空白处的最佳选项：_____ he will come to the meeting remains uncertain.
config.explanation: 正确答案 B。Whether 引导主语从句，表示「是否」，从句 he will come to the meeting 本身完整。A 选项 That 语法上可以引导主语从句，但语义不符——That 表示确定事实（他来开会这件事），而 remains uncertain 表示不确定，前后矛盾。C 选项 If 不能引导主语从句，只能引导宾语从句。D 选项 What 在从句中需充当成分，但从句已完整，无需 what。

config.title: 名词性从句引导词填空
config.stem:
用 that / whether / what / how 填空：
1. I don't know {{1}} he will accept the invitation.
2. {{2}} she said at the meeting was quite inspiring.
3. It is important {{3}} everyone follows the rules.
4. The problem is {{4}} we can finish the task on time.

blanks.hint: 从句缺 said 的宾语
It 形式主语，从句完整
表语从句表「是否」，if 不可

config.explanation: ① 宾语从句表「是否」，用 whether 或 if 均可。② 主语从句中缺少 said 的宾语，用 what（意为「她所说的话」）。③ It 作形式主语，that 引导真正的主语从句，从句完整且表示确定事实。④ 表语从句表「是否」，用 whether（if 不能引导表语从句）。

bullets: 名词性从句 = 一个完整句子充当名词，可作主语/宾语/表语/同位语
引导词：that（只连接，不充当成分） / whether（是否，可用于四种从句） / if（是否，仅限宾语从句） / wh-词（连接+充当成分）
that 名词性从句 vs that 定语从句：看从句是否完整——完整→名词性从句，缺成分→定语从句
it 作形式主语：It is + adj./n. + that 从句
it 作形式宾语：主语 + 谓语 + it + 宾补 + that/whether 从句
that 省略规则：仅宾语从句中可省略，其余不可省

objectives: 区分限制性定语从句与非限制性定语从句的本质差异
掌握关系代词 who/whom/which/that/whose 的选择规则
掌握 that 的特殊用法（只能用 that / 不能用 that 的情况）
理解介词+关系代词结构与关系副词 where/when/why 的用法
辨析定语从句与同位语从句

config.text: 定语从句是英语中最灵活的修饰工具——一个逗号的有无，决定了修饰的是「哪一个」还是「补充说明」。CET 翻译和写作中，定语从句是最常用的高级句型之一。

stat.label: 定语从句在CET翻译高频语法中的排名

config.rule: 定语从句 = 关系词引导的从句修饰前面的名词（先行词），关系词在从句中充当成分
config.formula: 先行词 + 关系词 + 从句（关系词在从句中作主语/宾语/定语/状语）
bullets:
限制性定语从句：无逗号，限定先行词的范围，去掉后句意不完整
   The students who work hard will succeed.（只有努力的学生才会成功）

非限制性定语从句：有逗号，补充说明先行词，去掉后句意仍完整
   My father, who is 60 years old, enjoys hiking.（补充说明父亲，只有一个父亲无需限定）
关系代词：who（人，主语）/ whom（人，宾语）/ which（物，主/宾语）/ that（人/物，主/宾语）/ whose（人/物，定语，表所属）
关系副词：where（地点） / when（时间） / why（原因）——在从句中作状语
核心原则：关系代词代替先行词在从句中充当成分，关系副词 = 介词+which 的简化

config.rule: that 的使用有严格的限制条件——两种极端：只能用 that / 绝不能用 that
config.formula: 限制性从句 + 特殊先行词 → 只能用 that；非限制性从句 / 介词后 → 不能用 that
bullets:
只能用 that 的情况（口诀：序数最高双重代，先行不日不which）：
① 先行词被序数词修饰：the first book that he read
② 先行词被最高级修饰：the best movie that I have seen
③ 先行词既有人又有物：the boy and his dog that passed by
④ 先行词是不定代词（all/everything/nothing/anything/little/much）：Everything that he said was true
⑤ 先行词被 the only/the very/the same 修饰：the only person that can help you

不能用 that 的情况：
① 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）：Beijing, which is the capital, is large.（✗ that）
② 介词之后：the house in which he lives（✗ in that）
③ 关系代词在从句中作宾语且指人时，正式文体用 whom：the professor whom I admire

examples.en: The woman who/that is standing there is our new manager.
examples.zh: 站在那里的那位女士是我们的新经理。
examples.analysis: 先行词 woman（人）→ who/that；从句缺主语 → who/that 充当主语

examples.en: The scientist whom/that I met yesterday won the Nobel Prize.
examples.zh: 我昨天见到的那位科学家获得了诺贝尔奖。
examples.analysis: 先行词 scientist（人）→ whom/that；从句缺宾语（met 缺宾语）→ whom/that 充当宾语，可省略

examples.en: The novel whose plot is thrilling became a bestseller.
examples.zh: 那本情节惊险的小说成了畅销书。
examples.analysis: 先行词 novel（物）→ whose 表所属；whose plot = the novel's plot（小说的情节）

examples.en: This is the best film that has been released this year.
examples.zh: 这是今年上映的最佳电影。
examples.analysis: 先行词 film 被最高级 best 修饰 → 只能用 that，不能用 which

config.title: 介词+关系代词 与 关系副词

examples.en: The house in which he lives is very old.
examples.zh: 他住的那栋房子非常老旧。
examples.analysis:
介词 in + 关系代词 which → in which = where
   也可写成：The house where he lives is very old.
   注意：介词+which 比 where 更正式，CET 阅读常见

examples.en: I still remember the day on which we first met.
examples.zh: 我仍然记得我们初次见面那天。
examples.analysis:
介词 on + 关系代词 which → on which = when
   也可写成：I still remember the day when we first met.

examples.en: That is the reason for which he was late.
examples.zh: 那就是他迟到的原因。
examples.analysis:
介词 for + 关系代词 which → for which = why
   也可写成：That is the reason why he was late.

config.title: 定语从句 vs 同位语从句

pairs.left: The news that he told me is exciting.
pairs.right: The news that he won the prize is exciting.
pairs.analysis:
左：定语从句。that 作 told 的宾语，从句不完整（缺宾语），that 代替 news 在从句中充当成分。
右：同位语从句。that 只起连接作用，从句完整（he won the prize），解释 news 的内容。

判断核心：删掉 that 后面的从句——
• 如果从句结构完整 → 同位语从句（that 不充当成分）
• 如果从句缺成分 → 定语从句（that 充当主/宾语）

config.stem: 下列哪个句子中的 which 不能替换为 that？

options.text: This is the most interesting book which I have ever read.
Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
The car which he bought last week was stolen.
She told me a story which I had never heard before.

config.explanation: B 是非限制性定语从句（有逗号），不能用 that 替换 which，这是硬性规则。A 中先行词被最高级 most interesting 修饰，应该用 that 而不是 which（A 本身语法不规范，但题目问的是「不能替换为 that」）；C 和 D 都是限制性定语从句，which 可以替换为 that。

config.stem: 填入空白处的最佳选项：The scientist and his achievements _____ we discussed yesterday are truly remarkable.
config.explanation: 正确答案 C。先行词是 the scientist and his achievements，既有人又有物，只能用 that（口诀：既人又物只用 that）。A 选项 which 只能指物；B 选项 who 只能指人；D 选项 whom 只能指人且作宾语。that 既可指人也可指物，是唯一正确的选择。

config.title: 关系词填空
config.stem:
用适当的关系词填空（that / which / who / whom / whose / where / when / why）：
1. The professor {{1}} thesis I borrowed is very famous.
2. Is there anything {{2}} I can do for you?
3. I will never forget the day {{3}} I graduated from college.
4. This is the hotel {{4}} we stayed during our trip.

blanks.hint: 先行词是不定代词 anything
先行词 the day，从句完整
先行词 the hotel，从句完整

config.explanation: ① whose 表所属关系，thesis 与 professor 之间是「教授的论文」，whose thesis = the professor's thesis。② 先行词是不定代词 anything，只能用 that。③ 先行词 the day（时间），从句结构完整，用关系副词 when（= on which）。④ 先行词 the hotel（地点），从句结构完整（we stayed 不缺宾语），用关系副词 where（= in which）。

bullets: 限制性 vs 非限制性：无逗号→限定范围（不可去）；有逗号→补充说明（可去）
关系代词选择：人→who/whom/that，物→which/that，所属→whose
只能用 that：序数/最高级/既人又物/不定代词/the only等先行词
不能用 that：非限制性从句（有逗号）和介词之后
介词+which = where/when/why 的正式写法
定语从句 vs 同位语从句：看从句是否完整——缺成分→定语从句，完整→同位语从句

objectives: 掌握九种状语从句的分类及常见引导词
辨析易混引导词：although/though/even though, because/since/as, if/unless
掌握真实条件句中「主将从现」原则
了解状语从句的省略结构

config.text: 状语从句为句子添加时间、条件、原因等背景信息——掌握九大类从句，就能读懂句与句之间的逻辑关系。

config.rule: 状语从句 = 修饰主句的从句，说明动作发生的时间/条件/原因/让步/目的/结果/方式/比较/地点
config.formula: 引导词 + 从句, 主句 / 主句 + 引导词 + 从句
bullets:
① 时间：when / while / as / before / after / until / since / as soon as
   I will call you when I arrive.

② 条件：if / unless / as long as / provided that
   If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.

③ 让步：although / though / even though / even if / while
   Although he was tired, he kept working.

④ 原因：because / since / as / now that
   Because she studied hard, she passed the exam.

⑤ 结果：so...that / such...that
   He was so tired that he fell asleep immediately.

⑥ 目的：so that / in order that
   Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.

⑦ 方式：as / as if / as though
   Do exactly as I told you.

⑧ 比较：than / as...as
   She is taller than her sister is.

⑨ 地点：where / wherever
   Put it where you found it.

config.rule: 易混引导词辨析——关注语义细微差别和搭配限制
config.formula: 语气强弱与搭配差异决定引导词选择
bullets:
although vs though vs even though：
   although — 最正式，语气最强，不与 but 连用
   though — 口语中可用，可作副词放句末（He is smart though.）
   even though — 强调让步的意外性（即使），语气最强
   ⚠️ 三者都不与 but 连用！（虽然…但是…只选一个）

because vs since vs as：
   because — 语气最强，回答 why，可放句首或句末
   since — 已知原因，语气较弱（既然），常放句首
   as — 语气最弱，最口语化（由于），常放句首

if vs unless：
   if — 如果（正条件）
   unless = if...not — 除非（反条件），注意 unless 本身含否定，不与 not 连用
   I won't go unless it stops raining. = I won't go if it doesn't stop raining.

so...that vs such...that：
   so + adj./adv. + that... / such + (a/an) + n. + that...
   so beautiful that... / such a beautiful girl that...

config.rule: 真实条件句中「主将从现」——主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来
config.formula: If/When/Unless + 从句(一般现在时), 主句(will/can/should + 动词原形)
bullets: 核心规则：时间/条件状语从句中，用一般现在时代替将来时
正确：If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.（✗ will rain）
正确：I will tell her when she arrives.（✗ will arrive）
正确：Unless you study hard, you won't pass.（✗ will study）
适用范围：if / when / unless / as soon as / before / after / until / as long as 引导的从句
⚠️ 注意：本节只讲真实条件句（可能发生的事）。虚拟条件句（与事实相反的条件句）见 Unit 6-3
判断方法：条件是否可能实现？可能→真实条件句（主将从现）；不可能→虚拟条件句（Unit 6-3）

config.title: 主将从现实战与常见错误

examples.en: If she comes tomorrow, we will discuss the plan.
examples.zh: 如果她明天来，我们将讨论这个计划。
examples.analysis:
✓ 从句用 comes（一般现在时），主句用 will discuss（将来时）
   错误写法：If she will come tomorrow...（✗ 从句不能用 will）

examples.en: I will send you an email as soon as I get the result.
examples.zh: 我一得到结果就给你发邮件。
examples.analysis:
✓ as soon as 引导时间状语从句，同样遵循主将从现
   错误写法：...as soon as I will get...（✗）

examples.en: We won't start the meeting until everyone arrives.
examples.zh: 直到所有人都到齐，我们才开始会议。
examples.analysis: ✓ until 引导时间状语从句，从句用 arrives（一般现在时表将来）

config.rule: 状语从句省略——当从句主语与主句主语一致且含有 be 动词时，可省略「主语+be」
config.formula: When/While/If/Although + (主语 + be) + 分词/形容词/介词短语
bullets:
完整：When (he was) in Rome, he visited many museums.
   省略：When in Rome, he visited many museums.

完整：While (she was) reading the book, she fell asleep.
   省略：While reading the book, she fell asleep.

完整：Although (he was) exhausted, he continued working.
   省略：Although exhausted, he continued working.

完整：If (it is) necessary, we can reschedule the meeting.
   省略：If necessary, we can reschedule the meeting.
⚠️ 省略条件：①从句主语 = 主句主语 ②从句含有 be 动词 ③两者同时省略，不能只省一个

config.stem: 下列哪个句子是正确的？

options.text: Although he is young, but he is very mature.
I will go to the party if I will have time.
She spoke so clearly that everyone understood her.
Since he was busy, so he couldn't come.

config.explanation: C 正确。so clearly that... 是结果状语从句，用法正确。A 错：although 和 but 不能连用（二选一）。B 错：if 条件状语从句中应用一般现在时 have，而非 will have（主将从现）。D 错：since 和 so 不能连用（因为…所以…只选一个），这与 although/but 规则一致。

config.stem: 句子 "Unless you hurry, you will miss the train." 中，unless 可以替换为：
config.explanation: 正确答案 A。unless = if...not（除非 = 如果不）。Unless you hurry = If you don't hurry。B 语义相反；C 语法错误；D even if 表示让步（即使），不表条件。注意：unless 本身含否定意义，不能再加 not。

config.title: 状语从句引导词填空
config.stem:
根据句意填入适当的引导词（if / unless / although / because / so that / so...that）：
1. {{1}} it was raining heavily, the match was not cancelled.
2. He worked overtime {{2}} he could finish the project on time.
3. I won't attend the meeting {{3}} it is absolutely necessary.
4. She was {{4}} nervous {{5}} she forgot her lines on stage.
config.explanation: ① 语境是「雨下得很大但比赛没有取消」，表让步，用 Although。② 工作加班的目的是按时完成项目，表目的，用 so that。③ 「除非绝对必要，否则不参加」，表反条件，用 unless。④ 「紧张到忘词」，so + adj. + that 表结果，是 so nervous that 的结构。

bullets: 九种状语从句：时间/条件/让步/原因/结果/目的/方式/比较/地点
although/though/even though 不与 but 连用；because/since/as 不与 so 连用
unless = if...not，本身含否定，不与 not 连用
so + adj./adv. + that... / such + n. + that... 表结果
主将从现：时间/条件从句用一般现在时代替将来时
⚠️ 本节只讲真实条件句——虚拟条件句（与事实相反的条件句）见 Unit 6-3
状语从句省略：从句主语与主句一致 + 含 be 动词 → 同时省略

能够拆解中等难度的嵌套从句（2-3层）
