config.text: 英语长难句的核心奥秘：从句套从句。一层嵌套是起点，三层嵌套是CET阅读的日常。学会拆解，再长的句子也能看懂。

stat.label: CET阅读中常见从句嵌套层数

config.rule: 从句嵌套 = 一个从句内部再包含另一个从句，形成层次结构
config.formula: 主句 → 一层从句 → 二层从句 → 三层从句（逐层嵌入）
bullets:
一层嵌套：主句 + 一个从句
   I know [that she is studying abroad].

两层嵌套：主句 + 一层从句 + 二层从句
   I know [that she believes [that hard work pays off]].

三层嵌套：主句 + 一层从句 + 二层从句 + 三层从句
   She said [that the report [which showed [that pollution was increasing]] was rejected].
核心原则：每层从句只属于一个「宿主」——要么修饰主句，要么修饰上一层从句中的某个成分
⚠️ 本卡片为入门级，聚焦2-3层中等难度例句。CET真题级复杂嵌套见 Unit 7-1

config.rule: 拆解五步法——从外到内，逐层剥开嵌套从句
config.formula: ① 找主句谓语 → ② 框出从句 → ③ 判断从句类型 → ④ 标注修饰关系 → ⑤ 翻译句意
bullets: ① 找主句谓语：先确定「谁做了什么」——主句的核心动词
② 框出从句：用方括号标出每个从句的起止位置（从引导词到从句谓语结束）
③ 判断从句类型：名词性从句 / 定语从句 / 状语从句
④ 标注修饰关系：这个从句修饰谁？充当什么成分？
⑤ 翻译句意：从内层到外层，先译从句再组装
小技巧：先数句中有几个谓语动词，就有几个分句（主句+从句）

examples.en: Scientists have discovered that the river which flows through the city is heavily polluted.
examples.zh: 科学家发现流经这座城市的那条河受到了严重污染。
examples.analysis:
① 主句谓语：have discovered
② 框出从句：
   一层：[that the river which flows through the city is heavily polluted]（宾语从句）
   二层：[which flows through the city]（定语从句，修饰 the river）
③ 从句类型：that从句→宾语从句；which从句→定语从句
④ 修饰关系：宾语从句作 discovered 的宾语；定语从句修饰 the river
⑤ 翻译：先译定语从句「流经城市的河」，再嵌回宾语从句「那条河受严重污染」，最后「科学家发现…」

config.title: 两层嵌套：定语从句套状语从句

examples.en: The professor who teaches the course that I am taking is writing a book because she wants to share her experience.
examples.zh: 教我正在上的那门课的教授正在写一本书，因为她想分享自己的经验。
examples.analysis:
① 主句谓语：is writing
② 框出从句：
   一层：[who teaches the course that I am taking]（定语从句，修饰 professor）
   二层：[that I am taking]（定语从句，修饰 course）
   一层：[because she wants to share her experience]（原因状语从句）
③ 类型：两个定语从句 + 一个状语从句
④ 修饰关系：who从句→修饰professor；that从句→修饰course；because从句→修饰主句
⑤ 翻译顺序：that I am taking「我正在上的」→ the course「课」→ who teaches the course「教那门课的教授」→ 主句「正在写书」→ because「因为想分享经验」

config.title: 三层嵌套：宾语从句套定语从句套表语从句

examples.en: He explained that the reason why the project which they proposed was rejected is that it lacked sufficient funding.
examples.zh: 他解释说，他们提出的那个项目被拒绝的原因是缺乏足够的资金。
examples.analysis:
① 主句谓语：explained
② 框出从句：
   一层：[that the reason why the project which they proposed was rejected is that it lacked sufficient funding]（宾语从句）
   二层：[why the project which they proposed was rejected]（定语从句，修饰 reason）
   三层：[which they proposed]（定语从句，修饰 project）
   另一层二：[that it lacked sufficient funding]（表语从句，作 is 的表语）
③ 类型：宾语从句 + 定语从句 + 定语从句 + 表语从句
④ 修饰关系：一层宾语从句作 explained 的宾语；why 从句修饰 reason；which 从句修饰 project；that 从句作 is 的表语
⑤ 翻译：which they proposed「他们提出的」→ the project「项目」→ why...was rejected「被拒的原因」→ the reason is that...「原因是缺乏资金」→ He explained「他解释说」

config.stem: 句子 "She told me that the book which I borrowed from the library was overdue." 中包含几个从句？
config.explanation: 正确答案 B，共2个从句：① that the book which I borrowed from the library was overdue 是宾语从句（told 的宾语）；② which I borrowed from the library 是定语从句（修饰 the book）。方法：数谓语动词——told, was, borrowed 共3个动词，减去主句1个，得2个从句。

config.title: 从句类型拆解填空
config.stem:
拆解句子，填写从句类型：
"I believe that the student who won the competition will receive a scholarship because her performance was outstanding."

1. that the student who won the competition will receive a scholarship → {{1}}从句
2. who won the competition → {{2}}从句
3. because her performance was outstanding → {{3}}从句
config.explanation: ① that 从句作 believe 的宾语 → 宾语从句。② who 从句修饰 the student → 定语从句。③ because 从句说明原因 → 原因状语从句。层次结构：主句(I believe) → 一层宾语从句(that...) → 二层定语从句(who...)；另外一层是原因状语从句(because...)修饰整个主句。

config.title: 长句拆解为简单句
config.instruction: 将下面的嵌套从句拆解为3个简单句，保持句意不变：
config.source: The manager announced that the employee who had made the mistake would be transferred because the company needed to maintain its reputation.
config.answer: ① The manager announced something. ② An employee had made the mistake. ③ The employee would be transferred. ④ The company needed to maintain its reputation.（或整合为：① The manager announced the decision. ② An employee had made a mistake. ③ The employee would be transferred. ④ The company needed to maintain its reputation.）
config.explanation:
拆解步骤：
① 主句：The manager announced (that...)
② that 宾语从句中的主语部分：the employee who had made the mistake → 拆出定语从句 → An employee had made the mistake.
③ that 宾语从句的核心：the employee would be transferred
④ because 原因状语从句：the company needed to maintain its reputation
关键：先找引导词和谓语动词，每个从句单独拎出就是一个简单句。

bullets: 从句嵌套 = 从句内再包含从句，形成层次结构
拆解五步法：①找主句谓语 → ②框出从句 → ③判断类型 → ④标注修饰关系 → ⑤翻译句意
小技巧：数谓语动词个数 = 分句个数（主句 + 从句总数）
翻译顺序：从内层到外层，先译最深层从句再逐步组装
长句→简单句：每个从句拆出为独立句子
本卡片为入门级（2-3层嵌套），CET真题级复杂长难句见 Unit 7-1

objectives: 掌握不定式在句中作主语、宾语、宾补、定语、状语、表语的用法
理解不定式的进行式（to be doing）和完成式（to have done）
区分不定式与动名词作宾语时的语义差异（stop to do vs stop doing）

config.text: 非谓语动词是英语中最灵活的语法现象——一个动词不充当谓语时，就变身成不定式、动名词或分词。先从不定式开始，它是非谓语的「主力军」。

stat.label: 不定式可作的句子成分

config.rule: 不定式 = to + 动词原形，可作主语、宾语、宾补、定语、状语、表语六种成分
config.formula: to + V原形 = 非谓语中的「多面手」，暗示「未做/目的/将来」
bullets: 作主语：To master a language requires practice.（掌握一门语言需要练习。）
作宾语：I decided to study abroad.（我决定出国留学。）
作宾补：The teacher asked us to hand in the paper.（老师让我们交论文。）
作定语：I have a lot of work to do.（我有很多工作要做。）
作状语：He got up early to catch the bus.（他早起赶公交。——目的状语）
作表语：My dream is to become a doctor.（我的梦想是成为一名医生。）

config.title: 不定式作各种成分详解

examples.en: To see is to believe.
examples.zh: 眼见为实。
examples.analysis: To see 作主语，to believe 作表语。不定式作主语常表示具体的、一次性的动作。当主语较长时，常用 it 作形式主语：It is important to learn English.

examples.en: She found it difficult to fall asleep.
examples.zh: 她发现很难入睡。
examples.analysis: it 是形式宾语，to fall asleep 是真正的宾语。常见结构：find / make / think / consider + it + adj. + to do

examples.en: He is the first to arrive and the last to leave.
examples.zh: 他第一个到，最后一个走。
examples.analysis: 不定式作定语，修饰序数词（the first / the last）或被最高级修饰的名词。注意不定式作定语常后置。

config.rule: 不定式有时态和语态变化：进行式（to be doing）表动作正在进行，完成式（to have done）表动作先于谓语完成
config.formula: 一般式 to do → 进行式 to be doing → 完成式 to have done → 被动式 to be done
bullets: 进行式 to be doing：He seems to be thinking about something.（他似乎正在想什么。）——动作与谓语同时发生且正在进行
完成式 to have done：She is said to have written three novels.（据说她已经写了三部小说。）——不定式动作先于谓语完成
完成进行式 to have been doing：They are reported to have been working on the project for two years.——强调持续到谓语时刻
被动式 to be done：The meeting is to be held next Monday.（会议将于下周一举行。）——不定式逻辑主语是动作承受者
完成被动式 to have been done：The building is said to have been completed last year.——先完成且被动

examples.en: want / decide / plan / hope / agree / refuse / offer / promise + to do
examples.zh: 想要/决定/计划/希望/同意/拒绝/主动提出/承诺 做某事
examples.analysis: 这些动词后面只能接不定式作宾语，不能接动名词。CET 高频词：afford to do / manage to do / fail to do / tend to do / claim to do

examples.en: be said / believed / reported / considered + to do
examples.zh: 据说/被认为/据报道/被认为 ……
examples.analysis:
被动语态 + 不定式是 CET 翻译和阅读中的高频结构：
He is said to be a genius. = It is said that he is a genius.
The company is reported to have made a profit. = It is reported that the company has made a profit.

examples.en: too...to / enough to / in order to / so as to
examples.zh: 太……以至于不能 / 足够……以至于 / 为了 / 以便
examples.analysis:
too...to 本身含否定意义：He is too tired to walk. = He is so tired that he cannot walk.
注意：only too...to 表示「非常愿意」：I'm only too glad to help.（我非常乐意帮忙。）

config.title: 不定式 vs 动名词作宾语：含义不同

examples.en: stop to do vs stop doing
examples.zh: 停下来去做另一件事 vs 停止正在做的事
examples.analysis:
stop to do：He stopped to smoke.（他停下来去抽烟。——to do 表目的，动作未发生）
stop doing：He stopped smoking.（他戒烟了/停止抽烟。——doing 表正在做的事）

examples.en: remember to do vs remember doing
examples.zh: 记得要做（未做） vs 记得做过（已做）
examples.analysis:
remember to do：Please remember to lock the door.（请记得锁门。——门还没锁）
remember doing：I remember locking the door.（我记得锁了门。——门已经锁了）

同理：forget to do（忘记要做）vs forget doing（忘记做过）
regret to do（遗憾要做）vs regret doing（后悔做了）

examples.en: try to do vs try doing
examples.zh: 努力/试图做 vs 试着做（看效果）
examples.analysis:
try to do：I tried to open the window.（我试图打开窗户。——强调努力的过程）
try doing：Try opening the window.（试试打开窗户。——尝试一种方法看效果）

config.title: 不定式练习 1
config.stem: The building is said _____ last year, but it still looks unfinished.
config.explanation: 主语 the building 是 complete 的承受者 → 被动，排除 A、C。动作 completed 发生在 last year，先于 is said → 用完成式。因此选 to have been completed（完成被动式）。句意：据说这栋建筑去年就已完工，但它看起来还没建好。

config.title: 不定式练习 2
config.stem:
—I remember _____ the door, but now it's open!
—Maybe you forgot _____ it.
config.explanation: 第一空：remember doing = 记得做过某事（记得锁了门）；第二空：forget to do = 忘记要做某事（忘记锁门）。句意：「我记得锁了门，但现在门是开着的！」「也许你忘了锁它。」

config.title: 不定式填空
config.stem:
用不定式的适当形式填空：

1. She is the first woman {{1}} (win) the Nobel Prize in this field.
2. The project is reported {{2}} (complete) ahead of schedule.
3. I found it impossible {{3}} (convince) him to change his mind.
4. He got up early in order {{4}} (catch) the first bus.
config.explanation: ① the first + 不定式作定语 → to win。② the project 与 complete 是被动关系，且完成先于 is reported → to have been completed。③ find it + adj. + to do 结构 → to convince。④ in order to + 动词原形 → to catch。

config.text: 不定式是非谓语动词中使用最广泛的形式，牢记其六种成分和时态语态变化
takeaway: 不定式可作主语/宾语/宾补/定语/状语/表语六种成分
进行式 to be doing：动作正在进行；完成式 to have done：动作先于谓语完成
want/decide/plan/hope/agree/refuse + to do（只接不定式）
be said/reported/believed + to do（被动+不定式）
stop/remember/forget/try/regret + to do vs doing 含义不同
形式主语/宾语 it：find it adj. to do / It is adj. to do

objectives: 掌握动名词作主语、宾语、表语、定语的用法
牢记只能接动名词作宾语的动词和短语
区分既可接不定式也可接动名词但含义不同的动词

config.text: 动名词长得和现在分词一模一样（V-ing），但身份不同——动名词是「名词化」的动词，能在句中充当名词能做的所有成分。

config.rule: 动名词 = V-ing 起名词作用，可作主语、宾语、表语、定语
config.formula: V-ing 作名词用 = 动名词 → 表示「做某事这件事」（抽象/习惯性动作）
bullets: 作主语：Smoking is harmful to health.（吸烟有害健康。——表示一般性、习惯性的行为）
作宾语：I enjoy reading novels.（我喜欢读小说。）
作表语：My hobby is collecting stamps.（我的爱好是集邮。）
作定语：a sleeping bag = 睡袋（sleeping 表示用途，不是正在睡觉的袋子）
动名词 vs 不定式作主语：动名词表习惯/抽象（Swimming is fun），不定式表具体/一次（To swim today is impossible）

config.rule: 只能接动名词的动词： enjoy / mind / avoid / suggest / finish / practice / consider / deny / imagine / risk / give up / cannot help / feel like
config.formula: MEGAFEPS + CARDS 记忆法（仅接 doing 的动词群）
bullets: enjoy doing：I enjoy listening to music.（享受做某事）
mind doing：Would you mind opening the window?（介意做某事）
avoid doing：He avoided answering the question.（避免做某事）
suggest doing：She suggested going by bus.（建议做某事）
finish doing：Have you finished writing the report?（完成做某事）
practice doing：She practices playing the piano every day.（练习做某事）
consider doing：We considered moving to another city.（考虑做某事）
deny doing：He denied stealing the money.（否认做过某事）
imagine doing：Can you imagine living on Mars?（想象做某事）
risk doing：He risked losing everything.（冒险做某事）
give up doing：She gave up smoking last year.（放弃做某事）
cannot help doing：I couldn't help laughing.（忍不住做某事）
feel like doing：I feel like taking a walk.（想做某事）
其他：appreciate / postpone / delay / admit / escape / miss / keep / be worth + doing

config.title: 既接不定式又接动名词但含义不同的动词

examples.en: remember / forget / regret
examples.zh: 记得/忘记/遗憾 → to do（未做） vs doing（已做）
examples.analysis:
remember to do = 记得要做（未做）：Remember to turn off the light.
remember doing = 记得做过（已做）：I remember turning off the light.

forget to do = 忘记要做（未做）：I forgot to call her.
forget doing = 忘记做过（已做）：I forgot calling her.（我忘了已经给她打过电话了）

regret to do = 遗憾地要做（未做）：I regret to tell you the bad news.
regret doing = 后悔做了（已做）：I regret telling him the secret.

examples.en: stop / try / mean / go on
examples.zh: 停止/尝试/意味/继续 → to do vs doing 语义对立
examples.analysis:
stop to do = 停下来去做（另一件事）：He stopped to rest.
stop doing = 停止做（正在做的事）：He stopped working.

try to do = 努力试图做：I tried to solve the problem.
try doing = 试做看效果：Try pressing the red button.

mean to do = 打算做：I didn't mean to hurt you.
mean doing = 意味着做：Success means working hard.

go on to do = 接着做另一件事：After dinner, he went on to do homework.
go on doing = 继续做同一件事：He went on working without a break.

config.rule: 动名词的完成式（having done）强调动作先于谓语完成，被动式（being done）表被动含义
config.formula: 主动完成 having done / 被动一般 being done / 被动完成 having been done
bullets:
完成式 having done：He denied having taken the money.（他否认拿了钱。——take 先于 deny 发生）
  比较：He denied taking the money.（一般式也常见，口语中多省略 having）
被动式 being done：I don't like being treated like a child.（我不喜欢被当作小孩对待。）
被动完成式 having been done：Having been told many times, he still made the same mistake.（被告知了很多次，他依然犯同样的错。）
名词/代词 + 动名词（逻辑主语）：Do you mind my opening the window? / He insisted on Tom's coming.（物主代词或名词所有格作动名词的逻辑主语）

config.title: 动名词 vs 不定式作宾语的核心区别

examples.en: like / love / prefer / hate + to do vs doing
examples.zh: 这些动词既可接 to do 也可接 doing，含义有细微差别
examples.analysis:
接 to do：表示具体某次行为（I'd like to go now. — 我现在想去。）
接 doing：表示一般性习惯（I like swimming. — 我喜欢游泳。）

但在实际考试中，两者区别不太严格。重点记住只能接一种形式的动词。

examples.en: need / want / require + doing = to be done
examples.zh: 动名词主动形式表被动意义
examples.analysis:
The room needs cleaning. = The room needs to be cleaned.（房间需要打扫。）
My car wants repairing. = My car wants to be repaired.（我的车需要修了。）

规律：当主语是物时，doing = to be done（主动形式，被动意义）

config.title: 动名词练习 1
config.stem:
—Would you mind _____ the window? It's too hot in here.
—Not at all.
config.explanation: mind 后只能接动名词 doing，不能接不定式。Would you mind doing...? 是请求别人做某事的礼貌表达。句意：「你介意开一下窗户吗？」「一点也不。」

config.title: 动名词练习 2
config.stem: Success means _____ your time and energy on what really matters.
config.explanation: mean doing = 意味着做某事（mean to do = 打算做某事）。句意「成功意味着把时间和精力投入到真正重要的事情上」，是「意味着」的含义，所以选 putting。主语是 you，与 put 是主动关系，不用被动 being put。

config.title: 动名词填空
config.stem:
用动名词的适当形式填空：

1. He narrowly avoided {{1}} (hit) by the car.
2. I cannot help {{2}} (admire) her courage.
3. The old house requires {{3}} (repair).
4. {{4}} (not receive) a reply, she wrote another letter.
config.explanation: ① avoid + doing，he 与 hit 是被动关系 → being hit。② cannot help + doing → admiring。③ require + doing，主动形式表被动意义 → repairing（= to be repaired）。④ Not having received 作状语，否定在 having 前面，动作先于谓语 wro 完成完成 → Not having received。

config.text: 动名词的核心是记住哪些动词只接 doing，以及 to do vs doing 的含义区别
takeaway: 动名词作主语/宾语/表语/定语（起名词作用）
只接 doing：enjoy/mind/avoid/suggest/finish/practice/consider/deny/imagine/risk/give up/cannot help/feel like
to do vs doing 含义不同：stop/remember/forget/try/regret/mean/go on
完成式 having done：动作先于谓语；被动式 being done：被动含义
need/want/require + doing = to be done（主动形式表被动）
逻辑主语：my/Tom's + doing

objectives: 区分现在分词与过去分词的核心差异（主动/进行 vs 被动/完成）
掌握分词作定语、状语、宾补的用法
理解独立主格结构的构成和功能

config.text: 分词是非谓语动词中最容易混淆的部分——现在分词和过去分词长得很不一样，但很多同学分不清何时用哪个。核心区别只有六个字：主动进行 vs 被动完成。

config.rule: 现在分词（V-ing）= 主动/进行；过去分词（V-ed）= 被动/完成
config.formula:
现在分词 → 事情「正在做」/ 逻辑主语是动作发出者
过去分词 → 事情「被做了」/ 逻辑主语是动作承受者
bullets: exciting news 令人兴奋的消息（消息使人兴奋 → 主动 → V-ing）
excited students 兴奋的学生们（学生被消息所兴奋 → 被动 → V-ed）
boiling water 正在沸腾的水（水正在开 → 进行 → boiling）
boiled water 开水（已经烧开的水 → 完成 → boiled）
a developing country 发展中国家（正在发展 → 进行 → V-ing）
a developed country 发达国家（已经发展成熟 → 完成 → V-ed）

config.title: 分词作定语：前置 vs 后置

examples.en: 前置定语：单个分词放在名词前面
examples.zh: a broken window 破碎的窗户 / a crying baby 哭泣的婴儿
examples.analysis:
单个分词作定语一般前置：
现在分词：falling leaves 落叶（正在落下）/ a sleeping child 熟睡的孩子
过去分词：fallen leaves 落叶（已落下）/ a retired teacher 退休教师

注意：falling（正在落）vs fallen（已落）体现进行 vs 完成的差异

examples.en: 后置定语：分词短语放在名词后面
examples.zh: The girl standing by the window is my sister. / The book written by him is a bestseller.
examples.analysis:
分词短语（分词+宾语/状语）作定语必须后置，相当于一个定语从句的缩略：
The girl standing by the window = The girl who is standing by the window
The book written by him = The book which was written by him

CET 高频考法：辨识分词短语并还原为定语从句理解

config.rule: 分词作状语：表示时间、原因、条件、伴随、结果等，逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
config.formula: 分词作状语 = 省略的状语从句（去掉连词+主语，动词变分词）
bullets: 时间状语：Walking along the street, I met an old friend. = When I was walking along the street, ...
原因状语：Tired and hungry, he went home. = Because he was tired and hungry, ...
条件状语：Given more time, I could do it better. = If I were given more time, ...
伴随状语：She sat by the window, reading a book. = She sat by the window and was reading a book.
结果状语：The fire lasted three hours, destroying the whole building.（火持续了三小时，结果摧毁了整栋楼。）——现在分词表自然而然的结果
⚠️ 否定式：Not knowing what to do, she asked for help.（Not 必须放在分词前面）

examples.en: Weather permitting, we will have a picnic tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果天气允许，我们明天去野餐。
examples.analysis:
独立主格 = 名词/代词 + 分词（/形容词/副词/不定式/介词短语），有自己的逻辑主语，不依赖主句主语。
Weather permitting = If weather permits（weather 是 permitting 的逻辑主语）

examples.en: The test finished, the students left the classroom one by one.
examples.zh: 考试结束后，学生们陆续离开了教室。
examples.analysis:
The test finished = After the test was finished（test 是 finished 的逻辑主语，且是被动关系 → 过去分词）

常见独立主格：
  All things considered = 考虑到所有因素（things 是 considered 逻辑主语，被动）
  The meeting over = 会议结束后（名词 + 副词）
  He came in, book in hand = 他走了进来，手里拿着书（名词 + 介词短语）

examples.en: There being no bus, we had to walk home.
examples.zh: 因为没有公交车了，我们只好步行回家。
examples.analysis:
There being no bus = Because there was no bus（There being 是 There be 的分词形式）
这是独立主格的一种特殊形式，CET 语法题中出现频率较高。

config.title: 分词作宾补：have / get / see / hear 等

examples.en: have / get sth done
examples.zh: 让某事被别人做（不是自己做）
examples.analysis:
I had my hair cut yesterday.（我昨天理发了。——别人帮我剪的）
I'll get my car repaired.（我要把车修了。——别人帮我修）

对比：have sb do sth = 让某人做某事（省略 to 的不定式）
I had him repair my car.（我让他修我的车。）

examples.en: see / hear / watch / notice + sb doing vs sb do vs sth done
examples.zh: 感官动词 + 宾补的三种形式
examples.analysis:
see sb doing = 看到某人正在做（强调进行）：I saw him crossing the street.
see sb do = 看到某人做了全过程：I saw him cross the street.
see sth done = 看到某事被做：I saw the window broken.

区别：doing 强调动作正在进行；do 强调动作全过程；done 强调被动/已完成的状态

config.title: 分词练习 1
config.stem: _____ in the mountains for a week, the explorers were finally rescued.
config.explanation: 主语 the explorers 与 trap 是被动关系（探险者被困），排除 A、C。被困的动作先于 were rescued 发生，应用完成被动式 Having been trapped。句意：在山里被困一周后，探险者们终于获救了。

config.title: 分词练习 2
config.stem: I can't get my car _____. The engine makes a strange noise.
config.explanation: get sth done = 让某事被做（让别人做/某事被完成）。get my car started = 让我的车被发动起来。starting 表示「正在发动」（进行），不符合语境。to start 是不定式，get sth to do 表示「让某物做某事」，语义不通。

config.title: 分词填空
config.stem:
用分词的适当形式填空：

1. The problem {{1}} (discuss) at the meeting yesterday is still unsolved.
2. {{2}} (not know) her phone number, I sent her an email instead.
3. Weather {{3}} (permit), we'll go hiking this weekend.
4. I noticed a stranger {{4}} (follow) me when I walked home.
config.explanation: ① problem 与 discuss 是被动关系（问题被讨论），且 yesterday 表示已完成 → discussed（过去分词作后置定语）。② 否定分词作状语，Not 放在分词前 → Not knowing。③ Weather permitting 是独立主格结构，Weather 是逻辑主语，主动关系 → permitting。④ notice sb doing（注意到某人正在做）→ following。

config.text: 分词的核心：现在分词 = 主动/进行，过去分词 = 被动/完成，作状语时注意逻辑主语一致
takeaway: 现在分词(V-ing)：主动/进行 → exciting/boiling/developing
过去分词(V-ed)：被动/完成 → excited/boiled/developed
分词作定语：单个前置，短语后置
分词作状语：时间/原因/条件/伴随/结果，逻辑主语=主句主语
独立主格：名词+分词（有自己的逻辑主语）
宾补：have sth done（让别人做）/ see sb doing（看到正在做）

card_shared_grammar_unit5_4_nonfinite_co.title: Unit 5-4：非谓语综合对比与解题策略

objectives: 掌握不定式、动名词、分词的功能对照与选择依据
建立非谓语动词的解题决策流程
识别并避免悬垂分词等常见错误

config.text: 学了不定式、动名词、分词三种非谓语，最大的挑战不是单独使用，而是在考试中快速判断该用哪个。这一卡片帮你建立一套决策系统。

config.title: 不定式 vs 动名词 vs 分词 功能对照表
rows:
✅ 具体动作
To swim today is fun.

✅ 抽象/习惯
Swimming is fun.

✅ 目的/未做
My dream is to fly.

✅ 抽象/习惯
My hobby is reading.

✅ 进行/特征
The news is exciting.

✅ 状态/感受
I am excited.

✅ 主动/进行
a crying baby

✅ 被动/完成
a broken cup

✅ 目的
to get there early

✅ 时间/原因/伴随
Walking in, he saw her

✅ 时间/原因/条件
Seen from the hill

✅ ask/tell 等
ask sb to do

config.rule: 非谓语解题三步法：①判断是否作谓语？→②作什么成分？→③语义是主动/被动/目的/伴随？
config.formula: Step1: 有谓语了吗？→ Step2: 空格在什么位置？→ Step3: 逻辑关系是什么？
bullets:
Step 1 — 是否作谓语？
  句中已有谓语动词 → 用非谓语；没有 → 填谓语动词（注意时态/语态/主谓一致）

Step 2 — 作什么成分？
  作主语/宾语 → 不定式 or 动名词
  作定语 → 三种皆可（看语义：目的→to do，用途→doing，被动→done）
  作状语 → 不定式(目的) or 分词(时间/原因/伴随/条件)
  作宾补 → 看前面的动词（ask→to do, see→doing, have→done）

Step 3 — 逻辑关系判断
  主动关系 → V-ing；被动关系 → V-ed；目的/将来 → to do
  动作先于谓语 → having done / to have done；动作与谓语同时 → doing / to be doing

config.title: 完形填空非谓语解题实战

examples.en: _____ (face) with a difficult situation, she remained calm.
examples.zh: 面对困难局面，她保持冷静。
examples.analysis:
Step1：句中已有谓语 remained → 用非谓语
Step2：句首，作状语
Step3：she 与 face 的关系 → 被动（她被面临/面对 → faced with）
答案：Faced with a difficult situation, she remained calm.

⚠️ 易错选 Facing：如果用 facing，意思是「她正在面对」（主动），语义也通。但 faced with 是固定搭配，表「面对……的处境」，更常见。

examples.en: The professor is said _____ (write) several books on AI.
examples.zh: 据说这位教授已经写了几本关于AI的书。
examples.analysis:
Step1：句中已有谓语 is said → 用非谓语
Step2：作宾语（is said 后面）
Step3：the professor 与 write 是主动关系，且 write 先于 is said 完成
答案：to have written

be said to have done = 据说已经做了（完成式，先于谓语）

examples.en: _____ (compare) with last year, the sales have increased by 20%.
examples.zh: 与去年相比，销售额增长了20%。
examples.analysis:
Step1：句中已有谓语 have increased → 用非谓语
Step2：句首，作状语
Step3：the sales 与 compare 是被动关系（销售额被比较）
答案：Compared with last year, ...

⚠️ compare 的特殊用法：
Compared with/to = 与……相比（固定搭配，过去分词）
Comparing A with B = 把A和B作比较（主动）

config.rule: 悬垂分词（Dangling Participle）：分词的逻辑主语与主句主语不一致，是常见语法错误
config.formula: 分词作状语 → 逻辑主语 = 主句主语，不一致就是悬垂分词
bullets:
❌ 悬垂分词：Walking down the street, the trees looked beautiful.
  （walking 的逻辑主语是人，但主句主语是 the trees → 树不能走路！）

✅ 修正：Walking down the street, I found the trees beautiful.
  （I 是 walking 的逻辑主语，与主句主语一致）

❌ 悬垂分词：Looking out of the window, a dog caught my attention.
  （looking 的主语是人，但主句主语是 a dog → 狗不能看窗外！）

✅ 修正：Looking out of the window, I noticed a dog.
  或：When I looked out of the window, a dog caught my attention.
⚠️ CET 写作中悬垂分词是扣分点，务必检查分词逻辑主语是否与主句主语一致

config.title: 综合练习 1
config.stem: _____ twice, the postman refused to deliver our letters unless we locked the dog.
config.explanation: Step1：句中已有谓语 refused → 用非谓语。Step2：句首作状语。Step3：the postman 与 bite 是被动关系（邮递员被咬），且 bite 先于 refused 发生 → 完成被动式 Having been bitten。句意：被咬了两次后，邮递员拒绝给我们送信，除非我们把狗锁起来。

config.title: 综合练习 2
config.stem: 下列哪个句子存在悬垂分词错误？

options.text: Seen from the top of the hill, the city looks beautiful.
Driving to work, the radio played my favorite song.
Written in simple English, the book is easy to understand.
Not knowing what to do, she asked her teacher for advice.

config.explanation: B 是悬垂分词：driving 的逻辑主语是人，但主句主语是 the radio（收音机不能开车）。应改为：Driving to work, I heard my favorite song on the radio. A 正确：the city 被 seen（城市被看到）。C 正确：the book 被 written（书被写）。D 正确：she 是 not knowing 的逻辑主语。

config.title: 综合填空
config.stem:
用非谓语动词的适当形式填空：

1. {{1}} (give) more time, we could have finished the project.
2. I still remember {{2}} (take) to the zoo by my father when I was little.
3. The lecture {{3}} (give) by Professor Wang was so inspiring that many students stayed {{4}} (ask) questions afterwards.
config.explanation: ① Given more time = If we had been given more time（条件状语，we 与 give 被动关系 → Given）。② remember doing（记得做过），I 与 take 是被动关系（被带去动物园）→ being taken。③ the lecture 与 give 是被动关系 → given 作后置定语。④ stayed to ask（留下来为了提问）→ 不定式作目的状语。

config.title: 综合改写
config.stem:
将下列状语从句改写为分词短语：
1. Because she was surprised by the news, she couldn't say a word.
2. After he had finished his homework, he went out to play.
answer: Surprised by the news, she couldn't say a word.
Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
config.explanation:
1. Because 从句 → 原因状语，主语 she 与 surprise 是被动关系 → Surprised by the news。去掉连词 Because 和主语 she，将 was surprised 变为过去分词 Surprised。
2. After 从句 → 时间状语，主语 he 与 finish 是主动关系，且 finish 先于 went 发生 → Having finished。去掉连词 After 和主语 he，将 had finished 变为完成式分词 Having finished。

config.text: 非谓语解题的核心是三步决策法：有谓语了吗？→ 空格在什么位置？→ 逻辑关系是什么？
takeaway: 不定式(to do)：目的/将来/未做 → 作主语/宾语/宾补/定语/状语/表语
动名词(doing)：抽象/习惯/经验 → 作主语/宾语/表语/定语
现在分词(doing)：主动/进行 → 作定语/状语/宾补/表语
过去分词(done)：被动/完成 → 作定语/状语/宾补/表语
解题三步法：①有谓语？②什么成分？③逻辑关系？
警惕悬垂分词：分词逻辑主语≠主句主语 = 语法错误

objectives: 掌握 It is/was...that/who... 强调句的结构和使用
学会区分强调句与 it 形式主语句
掌握 not...until 的强调变体

config.text: 同样一句话，强调不同的部分，传达的信息完全不同。强调句帮你将重点「框出来」——让读者一眼看到你想突出的内容。

config.rule: 强调句 = It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子剩余部分（去掉被强调部分的原句）
config.formula: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分
bullets: 强调主语：It is Tom that/who broke the window.（原句：Tom broke the window.）
强调宾语：It was the window that Tom broke.（原句：Tom broke the window.）
强调状语：It was yesterday that Tom broke the window.（原句：Tom broke the window yesterday.）
强调人时用 that 或 who 均可，强调物/状语时只能用 that
时态：原句是现在时用 It is，是过去时用 It was
⚠️ 不能强调谓语动词——强调动词用 do/does/did：I do like it. / She did come.

config.title: 强调句 vs it 形式主语句（CET高频易混点）

items.label: 强调句
items.description: It was in the park that we met.（正是在公园里我们见面了。）→ 去掉 It was...that：In the park we met. ✓ 成立！

items.label: It 形式主语
items.description: It was surprising that we met in the park.（我们在公园见面，这很令人惊讶。）→ 去掉 It was...that：Surprising we met in the park. ✗ 不成立！

config.rule: 辨别法：去掉 It is/was...that 后，剩余部分能否组成一个完整的句子——能则是强调句，不能则是 it 形式主语句。

examples.en: It was not until + 时间点 + that + 句子
examples.zh:
普通句：I didn't realize the truth until he told me.
强调变体：It was not until he told me that I realized the truth.
examples.analysis:
not...until 变为强调句时，not 前移到 It was 后面，until 从句紧跟其后，主句用肯定形式（去 not）

核心变化：
  原句：主语 + not + 谓语 + until...
  强调：It was not until... + that + 主语 + 谓语（肯定）

更多例句：
  He didn't come back until midnight.
  → It was not until midnight that he came back.

注意：主句谓语由否定变肯定！

config.title: 强调句辨别练习
config.stem: 下列哪个句子是强调句（可以还原为正常语序）？

options.text: It is a fact that he was late for the meeting.
It was John that borrowed the book from the library.
It is important that he attend the meeting on time.
It is said that the building will be completed next year.

config.explanation: B 去掉 It was...that 后得到 John borrowed the book from the library. ✓ 成立 → 强调句。A 去掉后 a fact he was late 不成立 → 形式主语句；C 去掉后 important he attend 不成立 → 虚拟语气固定句型(It is + adj. + that sb (should) do)；D 去掉后 said the building 不成立 → 被动固定表达(It is said that...)。

config.title: 强调句综合练习
config.stem: "It was not until she arrived at the airport _____ she realized she had left her passport at home." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: It was not until...that... 是固定句式，横线只能是 that。A when 仅在强调时间状语时可能混淆（但此处是 not until 结构，不是单纯的时间状语）；B before 不符合强调句结构；D which 不用于强调句（强调物/状语用 that，强调人用 that/who）。口诀：not until 强调句，that 不能省。

config.title: 强调句填空
config.stem:
用强调句式改写下列句子：

1. Tom broke the window yesterday.（强调主语 Tom）
→ {{1}} broke the window.

2. I didn't finish the work until midnight.（用 it was not until 强调）
→ {{2}} that I finished the work.

3. The teacher praised Mary for her hard work.（强调宾语 Mary）
→ {{3}} the teacher praised for her hard work.

4. I met my old friend in the park last Sunday.（强调地点状语）
→ {{4}} I met my old friend last Sunday.

blanks.hint: 强调宾语：It is/was + 宾语 + that/whom

answer: It was in the park that
blanks.hint: 强调地点状语：It is/was + 状语 + that

config.explanation: ① 强调主语 Tom → It was Tom that/who。② not...until 强调变体 → It was not until midnight that（原句 I didn't finish → 强调句主句变肯定 I finished）。③ 强调宾语 Mary → It was Mary that/whom。④ 强调地点状语 in the park → It was in the park that（状语前保留介词 in）。

config.text: 强调句 = It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余——核心是用「框架」把重点框出来
takeaway: 结构：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余（去掉被强调部分后的原句）
强调人→that/who；强调物/状语→只能用 that
辨别法：去掉 It is...that 后句子成立→强调句；不成立→it形式主语
not until 强调：It was not until...that...（主句用肯定！）
谓语动词不能这样强调→用 do/does/did：I did finish it!
强调句的 is/was 不与被强调部分的主谓一致——始终用 is/was

objectives: 掌握完全倒装与部分倒装的区别和用法
熟悉否定词/only提前引起的部分倒装
掌握虚拟条件句中省略if的倒装结构

config.text: 倒装句改变语序不是为了装文艺——它是英语中表达强调、否定和条件的「语法机关枪」，尤其是否定词开头时，不倒装就错了。

stat.label: 完全倒装 vs 部分倒装

config.rule: 倒装句分两大类型：完全倒装（整个谓语提前）和部分倒装（只把助动词/情态动词提前）
config.formula: 完全倒装：状语 + 谓语 + 主语 | 部分倒装：否定词/Only + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词原形
bullets: 完全倒装（Full Inversion）：整个谓语动词移到主语前面
→ Here comes the bus.（公共汽车来了）← 方位副词 here/there 开头
→ On the table sat a cat.（桌子上坐着一只猫）← 地点状语开头
→ 主语是人称代词时不倒装：Here you are.（不说 Here are you.）
部分倒装（Partial Inversion）：只把助动词/情态动词/be动词移到主语前面
→ Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.（我从未见过如此美丽的日落）
→ Not only does he speak English, but he also speaks French.
→ Only in this way can we solve the problem.
→ Hardly had I arrived when the phone rang.
核心区别：完全倒装 = 整个谓语跑前面（方位/地点触发）；部分倒装 = 助动词跑前面（否定词/Only触发）

config.title: 部分倒装常见触发词（CET高频）

examples.en: 否定词/半否定词提前
examples.zh: Never / Seldom / Rarely / Little / Nowhere + 倒装
examples.analysis:
Never have I been so touched.
Seldom does he complain about his work.
Little did she know about the danger.

⚠️ Not only...but also 倒装前句，后句不倒装：
Not only did he finish the work, but he also helped others.

examples.en: Hardly/Scarcely...when, No sooner...than
examples.zh:
Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
No sooner had she left than he arrived.
examples.analysis: Hardly/Scarcely后接when，No sooner后接than，主句用过去完成时倒装（had + 主语 + done），从句用一般过去时。

examples.en: Only + 状语提前
examples.zh:
Only in this way can we succeed.
Only when he came back did I realize the truth.
examples.analysis: Only 修饰状语提前时，主句倒装。⚠️ Only 修饰主语不倒装：Only Tom knew the answer.（Only 修饰主语 Tom，不倒装）

examples.en: So/Such...that 倒装
examples.zh:
So fast did he run that nobody could catch him.
Such a good student is she that everyone admires her.
examples.analysis: So + adj/adv 提前，或 Such + n 提前，主句倒装，that 从句不倒装。

config.title: 虚拟条件句省略 if 的倒装（与 6-3 关联）

examples.en: 省略 if 的虚拟倒装
examples.zh:
Had I known the truth, I would have told you. = If I had known the truth...
Were I you, I would accept the offer. = If I were you...
Should he arrive late, please wait for him. = If he should arrive late...
examples.analysis:
虚拟条件句 if 可以省略，此时将 Had/Were/Should 提前到句首完成倒装。
规则：①原句有 had/were/should → 往前移到句首 ②如果没有 → 不能省 if

Had I known = 与过去相反（原句 If I had known）
Were I you = 与现在相反（原句 If I were you）
Should he come = 与将来相反（原句 If he should come）

config.title: 倒装类型判断
config.stem: 句子 "Never before _____ such rapid technological change." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: Never before 是否定词提前 → 部分倒装 → 助动词 + 主语 + 动词。正确结构：has the world witnessed。A 和 C 没有倒装；D 倒装了但 did + witnessed 动词形式错误（应为 witness 原形）。句意：世界从未见证过如此迅速的技术变革。

config.title: 倒装与不倒装区分
config.stem: 下列哪个句子使用了正确的倒装结构？（可能有多个正确）

options.text: Only by working hard you can achieve your goal.
Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
So beautiful was the scenery that we forgot to take pictures.

config.explanation: A 错误：Only + 方式状语提前 → 主句需倒装，应为 can you achieve。B 正确：Not only 提前 → 部分倒装 + 后句不倒装。C 错误：Here comes the bus（完全倒装，主语是名词 the bus）→ 但 Here you are 时主语是人称代词 you 就不倒装。the bus 是名词不是代词，所以应倒装为 Here comes the bus。D 正确：So beautiful 提前 → 主句倒装 was the scenery → So adj was + 主语 + that...

config.title: 正常句→倒装句改写
config.stem: 将下列句子改写为倒装句：

items.original: I have never seen a more beautiful sunset.
If I had known the truth earlier, I would have made a different decision.
He was so tired that he fell asleep immediately.
He not only speaks English but also writes it fluently.
items.hint: Not only 提前，前句倒装

referenceAnswers: Never have I seen a more beautiful sunset.
Had I known the truth earlier, I would have made a different decision.
So tired was he that he fell asleep immediately.
Not only does he speak English, but he also writes it fluently.
config.explanation:
① Never 提前 → 部分倒装 Never have I...
② 虚拟条件句省略 if → Had I known...（过去完成时 had 提前）
③ So + adj 提前 → So tired was he that...
④ Not only 提前 → Not only does he speak...（后句不倒装）

config.text: 倒装是「标记信号」——否定词和 Only 一出现，主谓就得颠个倒
takeaway: 完全倒装：方位副词/地点状语开头 → 整个谓语提前（Here comes... / On the table sat...）
部分倒装：否定词/Only+状语开头 → 助动词提前（Never have I... / Only then did I...）
人称代词主语 → Here/There 后不倒装：Here you are.（非 Here are you.）
虚拟条件省略 if：Had/Were/Should 提前到句首（Had I known... = If I had known...）
Not only...but also → 前句倒装，后句不倒装
Only 修饰主语时不倒装：Only he can solve it.（非 Only can he solve it.）

objectives: 区分真实条件句（4-3）与虚拟条件句（本节），理解'时态后退'原则
掌握三类 if 虚拟条件句的时间关系
学会虚拟条件句中省略 if 的倒装结构
掌握 wish / if only / as if / as though 后的虚拟用法

config.text: ⚠️ 本节与 Unit 4-3 的真实条件句完全不同！4-3 的 If it rains, I will stay home 是「可能发生的事」——真实条件句。而本节的 If I were you, I would go 是「与事实相反」——虚拟条件句。两套体系的时态规则完全不同，混用是 CET 高频失分点。

config.rule: 虚拟条件句的核心原则：时态后退一步——用过去的时态表达现在/将来的假设，用更过去的时态表达过去的假设
config.formula:
与现在相反：If + 过去式, would/could/might + 动词原形
与过去相反：If + had done, would/could/might + have done
与将来相反：If + were to do / should do / 过去式, would + 动词原形
bullets: ⚡ 与现在事实相反：If + 过去式, would/could/might + V原
→ If I had enough money, I would buy a new car.（实际：我现在没钱）
→ 注意：be 动词一律用 were（If I were you, I would...）
⚡ 与过去事实相反：If + had done, would/could/might + have done
→ If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.（实际：过去没努力学习，没通过考试）
→ 这是 CET 最高频考点，had done + would have done 是标志搭配
⚡ 与将来事实相反（可能性极小）：If + were to do / should do, would + V原
→ If the sun were to rise in the west, I would believe you.（太阳从西边升起的可能性极小）
→ should do 表达万一（还有一丝可能）：If it should rain, take an umbrella.
⚠️ 真实 vs 虚拟对照表：
真实：If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.（可能下雨）
虚拟：If it rained tomorrow, I would stay home.（明天不太可能下雨）
虚拟：If it had rained yesterday, I would have stayed home.（昨天没下雨）

config.title: 虚拟语气省略 if 的倒装（联系 6-2）

examples.en: 省略 if → Had/Were/Should 提前
examples.zh:
Had I known the truth, I would have told you.
= If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
examples.analysis:
原句有 had/were/should 时可以省略 if，将这三个词提前到句首完成倒装。

规则总结：
  与过去相反 → Had + 主语 + done: Had he come earlier, he would have met her.
  与现在相反 → Were + 主语: Were I you, I would refuse.
  与将来相反 → Should + 主语 + do: Should it be necessary, let me know.

⚠️ 只有 had/were/should 能这样用——如果没有这三个词（如一般过去式动词），不能省略 if：
  If she lived here... → 不能省，因为 lived 不是 had/were/should

⚠️ 否定形式：Had I not known...（非 Hadn't I known...，正式书面语不缩写）

config.title: wish / if only / as if / as though 后的虚拟

examples.en: wish 后的虚拟（但愿……实际上不是）
examples.zh:
I wish I were taller = 我希望我更高（实际上现在不高）
I wish I had known earlier = 我希望我早知道（实际过去不知道）
I wish you would come = 真希望你会来（表示愿望）
examples.analysis:
wish + 过去式 = 与现在相反（希望现在不是这样）
wish + had done = 与过去相反（后悔过去没做/做了某事）
wish + would do = 对将来的愿望（抱怨/希望改变）

examples.en: if only（要是……就好了）
examples.zh:
If only I had listened to your advice! = 要是我听了你的建议就好了！
If only it would stop raining! = 要是雨能停就好了！
examples.analysis:
if only = I wish，表达强烈愿望，后接虚拟语气。
if only + 过去式（现在）/ had done（过去）/ would do（将来）

examples.en: as if / as though（好像……实际上不是）
examples.zh:
He talks as if he knew everything.（他说话的样子好像什么都知道——实际不知道）
She looked as though she had seen a ghost.（她看上去好像见了鬼——实际没见）
examples.analysis:
as if/though 从句描述非真实情况时，用虚拟语气。
as if + 过去式（与现在相反）/ + had done（与过去相反）

⚠️ as if 也可接真实情况（可能性大）：It looks as if it is going to rain. — 这句不是虚拟，因为看起来真的要下雨。

config.title: 虚拟条件句时间判断
config.stem: "If I _____ about the meeting earlier, I would have attended it." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: 主句 would have attended → 与过去事实相反的标志（would + have done）。与过去相反的 if 从句用 had done → had known。A know 是现在时，不用于虚拟。B knew 是过去式，用于与现在相反的虚拟（If I knew...I would...）。D would know 不用于 if 从句中。口诀：主句 would have done → 从句 had done。

config.title: 真实vs虚拟辨别
config.stem:
比较两个句子，判断哪个是真实条件句，哪个是虚拟：
① If he comes tomorrow, I will tell him the news.
② If he came tomorrow, I would tell him the news.

options.text: ①是真实条件句，②是虚拟（与将来相反）

config.explanation: ① If + 一般现在时(comes)，主句 will → 真实条件句（他明天有可能来）。② If + 过去式(came)，主句 would → 虚拟语气（他明天不太可能来）。两者时态完全不同：真实条件句的时态不后退，虚拟条件句的时态后退一步。这是 CET 核心考点——根据主句的 will vs would 就能判断类型。

config.title: 虚拟条件句填空
config.stem:
用动词的正确虚拟形式填空：

1. If I {{1}} (be) you, I {{2}} (not accept) the offer.
2. If she {{3}} (study) harder last semester, she {{4}} (pass) the exam.
3. I wish I {{5}} (can) fly like a bird.
4. He looked as if he {{6}} (not sleep) for three days.
5. If the sun {{7}} (rise) in the west tomorrow, I {{8}} (believe) you.

blanks.hint: 与现在相反：be动词一律用were
与现在相反主句：would + V原
与过去相反主句：would have done
wish + 过去式 = 与现在相反
as if + had done = 与过去相反
与将来相反（极小可能）：were to do / should do
与将来相反主句：would + V原

config.explanation: ① 与现在相反：If I were you, I would not accept。② 与过去相反：If she had studied...she would have passed。③ wish + 过去式 = 与现在相反。④ as if + had done = 与过去相反。⑤ 与极小可能的将来相反：were to rise / should rise → would believe。

config.text: 虚拟条件句 = 时态后退一步——用过去讲现在，用过去的过去讲过去，学不会后退就是学不会虚拟语气
takeaway: ⚡ 核心区分：真实条件句（4-3）：时态不后退 | 虚拟条件句（6-3）：时态后退一步
与现在相反：If + 过去式(be用were), would + V原
与过去相反：If + had done, would have done ← CET最高频
与将来相反：If + were to/should + do, would + V原
省略 if 倒装：Had/Were/Should + 主语（Had I known = If I had known）
wish / if only / as if 后也用虚拟：过去式（现在）/ had done（过去）
判断技巧：看主句 → will 是真实，would 是虚拟；would have done 一定与过去相反

objectives: 掌握 demand/suggest/insist 等词后的 should + 动词原形型虚拟
区分本节 should 型虚拟与 3-6 情态动词 should 的含义区别
掌握 It is (high) time that 和 would rather 后的虚拟用法

config.text: ⚠️ 这里的 should 和 Unit 3-6 情态动词的 should 完全不同！3-6 的 should 表「建议/应当」（语气弱），而本节的 should 带强制性，在正式英语中常被省略，动词直接用原形。

config.rule: should 型虚拟：表示命令、建议、要求等强制性概念时，that 从句用 should + 动词原形（should 可省略，直接用动词原形）
config.formula: demand/suggest/insist/order/require/recommend + that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形
bullets: ① 动词型：demand/suggest/insist/order/require/recommend/command/request/advise/propose + that sb (should) do
→ The doctor suggested that he (should) take more exercise.（医生建议他多运动）
→ The boss demanded that the report (should) be finished by Friday.（老板要求报告周五前完成）
→ We insist that she (should) attend the meeting.（我们坚持她出席会议）
② 形容词型：It is necessary/important/essential/strange/natural/vital + that sb (should) do
→ It is necessary that everyone (should) be present.（每个人到场是必要的）
→ It is essential that the equipment (should) be checked before use.（设备使用前必须检查）
③ 名词型：suggestion/proposal/recommendation/demand + that sb (should) do
→ His suggestion that we (should) start early was accepted.
⚠️ 与 3-6 情态动词 should 的本质区别：
3-6：You should study harder. → 建议（语气弱），should 不能省略
6-4：I suggest that you (should) study harder. → 强制性，should 可省略
测试方法：如果 should 能省略而句子依然成立，就是 should 型虚拟
⚠️ suggest = 暗示/表明 时不用虚拟：His expression suggested that he was unhappy.（suggest = 暗示，宾语从句用真实时态）
⚠️ insist = 坚持说/坚称 时不用虚拟：He insisted that he was innocent.（insist = 坚称，用真实时态）

config.title: It is (high) time that + 虚拟（该做某事的时机了）

examples.en: It is (high) time that sb did = 是该做某事的时候了（实际还没做）
examples.zh:
It is time that we left.（我们该走了——还没走）
It is high time that you started working.（你早该开始工作了——还没开始）
examples.analysis:
It is (high/about) time that 后用过去式或 should + 动词原形：
  ① 过去式：It is time that we left. ← 更常见
  ② should + 动词原形：It is time that we should leave. ← should 不省略

⚠️ 与 should 型虚拟不同：这里 should 不省略，意思也不一样——表达的是「时机到了」而非「强制性命令」

examples.en: would rather sb did / had done = 宁愿某人做（事实并非如此）
examples.zh:
I would rather you stayed here.（我宁愿你留下——实际你可能要走）
I would rather you had told me earlier.（我宁愿你早点告诉我——实际你没早说）
examples.analysis:
would rather (that) sb + 过去式 → 与现在/将来相反
  → I'd rather you went tomorrow.（宁愿你明天去——而不是现在去）

would rather (that) sb + had done → 与过去相反
  → I'd rather she hadn't said that.（宁愿她没说那话——实际说了）

would rather + 动词原形（没有 sb）→ 不用虚拟：
  → I'd rather stay home.（我宁愿待在家——个人选择，不涉及虚拟）

关键：would rather 后面出现独立主语 sb 时，才触发虚拟！

config.title: should 型虚拟练习
config.stem: "The manager demanded that all employees _____ the training session." 横线处应填？（美国英语）
config.explanation: demand + that 从句用 should 型虚拟 → 动词用原形（should 省略后直接用原形 attend）。B attended 是过去式，不是虚拟应有的形式；C attending 是动名词，无法在此处作谓语；D attends 有三单变化，虚拟形式应是原形不变。核心：demand/suggest/insist 等词后的 that 从句，动词永远用原形（无人称和时态变化），美式英语省略 should。

config.title: 虚拟 vs 非虚拟辨别
config.stem: "His pale face suggested that he _____ ill." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: suggest 在此意为「暗示/表明」而非「建议」，后面不用虚拟语气，用真实时态。He was ill 描述过去事实 → 用 was。A be（原形）和 C should be 是虚拟形式，但这里 suggest 不表建议；D were 是过去式虚拟（用于 wish/as if 等）。判断口诀：suggest = 建议 → 虚拟；suggest = 暗示/表明 → 真实时态。同理 insist = 要求/坚持要 → 虚拟；insist = 坚称 → 真实时态。

config.title: 虚拟语气其他用法填空
config.stem:
用动词的正确虚拟形式填空：

1. It is necessary that every student {{1}} (wear) a school uniform.
2. The doctor recommended that he {{2}} (take) more exercise every day.
3. It is high time that you {{3}} (make) a decision.
4. I would rather you {{4}} (not tell) him the truth yesterday.
5. His proposal that the meeting {{5}} (postpone) was supported by everyone.

blanks.hint: It is necessary that → should型虚拟
It is high time → 过去式或should+V原
would rather + 过去完成→与过去相反

config.explanation: ① It is necessary that → should 型虚拟：wear / should wear。② recommend that → should 型虚拟：take / should take。③ It is high time → 过去式 / should + 动词原形：made / should make。④ would rather + had done = 对过去的虚拟：hadn't told。⑤ proposal that → should 型虚拟 + 被动语态：be postponed / should be postponed。

config.text: should 型虚拟 = 强制性（命令/建议/要求），should 可省略直接加原形——区别于 3-6 的建议型 should
takeaway: should 型虚拟（最核心）：demand/suggest/insist + that sb (should) do → 美式英语省略 should，直接用原形
形容词型：It is necessary/important/essential that sb (should) do
名词型：suggestion/proposal + that sb (should) do
⚠️ suggest = 暗示 / insist = 坚称 → 不用虚拟，用真实时态
It is (high) time that sb did → 该做某事了（过去式或 should do，should 不省略）
would rather sb did（现在/将来）/ had done（过去）→ 宁愿某人做（虚拟）
与 3-6 区别：3-6 should = 建议（弱），6-4 (should) = 强制（强，可省略）

objectives: 掌握 as...as 结构的肯定和否定形式
掌握 the more...the more 句型和倍数表达
学会比较级的修饰词和并列比较结构

config.text: 比较级不只是加 -er 那么简单——从倍数表达到连锁比较，英语的比较结构是一套精密的语义工具。

config.rule: 比较结构是英语中表达程度差异的语法体系，从原级比较到倍数比较，每种结构都有固定公式
config.formula: as...as（原级比较）/ 比较级+than（差级比较）/ the+比较级, the+比较级（连锁比较）/ 倍数+as...as（倍数比较）
bullets: ① 原级比较：as + adj/adv + as（肯定）
→ She is as tall as her mother.（她和她妈妈一样高）
→ 否定：not as/so + adj/adv + as
→ He is not so tall as his brother.（他没有哥哥高）
② 差级比较：比较级 + than
→ This book is more interesting than that one.
→ 单音节：-er（taller, faster）；多音节：more + 原级（more beautiful）
③ 连锁比较：the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...（越……越……）
→ The harder you work, the more you will achieve.（越努力，收获越多）
→ The more, the better.（多多益善）
④ 渐进比较：比较级 + and + 比较级（越来越……）
→ It is getting colder and colder.（天气越来越冷）
→ She is becoming more and more beautiful.（她越来越美）
⑤ 倍数表达（CET高频）：
→ A is twice/three times as + 原级 + as B（A是B的X倍）
→ A is twice/three times + 比较级 + than B（A比B…X倍）
→ A is twice/three times the size/length of B（A的大小是B的X倍）
→ The room is three times as large as that one. = 这房间是那间的三倍大
⑥ 比较级修饰词（增强/减弱比较程度）：
→ 强修饰：much / a lot / far / even / still
→ It is much better than I expected.（比我想象的好得多）
→ 弱修饰：a little / a bit / slightly
→ She is a little taller than me.（她比我高一点点）

config.title: the more...the more 句型详解

examples.en: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...
examples.zh:
The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
The more you practice, the better you become.
The more expensive the hotel is, the better the service is.
examples.analysis:
前半句是条件（越……），后半句是结果（就越……）。

结构要求：前后都必须是「the + 比较级」
可以是形容词比较级：The faster, the better.
可以是副词比较级：The more carefully you drive, the safer you are.

⚠️ 常见陷阱：
The more you eat, the fatter you get.（不是 the more fat，fat 的比较级是 fatter）
句子顺序固定：the + 比较级 在前，the + 比较级 在后
主语在前后分句可以不同，但必须都出现

config.title: 倍数表达三种结构对比（CET高频翻译题）

examples.en: 三种倍数表达（以三倍为例）
examples.zh:
① The room is three times as big as that one.
② The room is three times bigger than that one.
③ The room is three times the size of that one.
examples.analysis:
三种结构都表示「这房间是那间的三倍大」：

结构①：倍数 + as + 原级 + as（最直白，as...as表示同等程度）
结构②：倍数 + 比较级 + than（倍数放前面，注意是times bigger不是times more big）
结构③：倍数 + the + 名词(size/length/weight) + of

⚠️ 常犯错误：
  ❌ three times as bigger as → 应为 three times as big as（as...as中间用原级）
  ❌ three times more big than → 应为 three times bigger than（比较级，big比较级是bigger）

更多倍数词：half（一半）/ twice（两倍）/ three times（三倍）/ four times（四倍）……

config.title: 比较结构综合练习
config.stem: "The output of our factory this year is _____ that of last year." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: 两倍固定用 twice，非 two times。「是……的两倍」用 twice as much as（不可数名词 output）。A two times 不是标准英语表达；C more as 不成立（more 应接 than）；D twice more as 不成立（应该就是 twice as much as 或 twice more than）。口诀：两倍 twice，三倍及以上用 times；as...as 中间是原级。

config.title: the more...the more 练习
config.stem: "The ____ you study, the ____ grades you will get." 横线处应填？
config.explanation: the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语。前后都需要比较级形式。hard 的比较级是 harder（单音节加 -er，非 more hard），good 的比较级是 better（不规则）。A 后部分用了 good（原级），不是比较级；C more hard 错误（单音节不用 more）；D more harder 双重比较级，错误。

config.title: 比较级填空
config.stem:
用提示词的正确比较形式填空：

1. He runs as {{1}} (fast) as a professional athlete.
2. This problem is {{2}} (much) difficult than I thought.
3. The {{3}} (early) you leave, the {{4}} (soon) you will arrive.
4. This building is three times the {{5}} (high) of that one.
5. The weather is getting {{6}} (cold) and {{7}} (cold).

blanks.hint: 多音节比较级 more + 原级；much修饰比较级表示
the 比较级..., the 比较级...—early比较级
three times the + 名词 + of
比较级 and 比较级：越来越
比较级 and 比较级：越来越

config.explanation: ① as...as 中间用原级 fast（不是 faster）。② difficult 多音节→more difficult；much 修饰比较级加强语气→much more difficult。③④ the earlier, the sooner（连锁比较）。⑤ 倍数+the+名词+of → three times the height of。⑥⑦ 比较级 and 比较级表示越来越→colder and colder。

config.text: 比较级不只是形式变化——每个结构都是精确的语义工具：as...as 表同等，比较级 than 表差级，the more 表连锁，倍数 as...as 表倍数
takeaway: as + 原级 + as（肯定）/ not so/as + 原级 + as（否定）
比较级 + than：单音节加 -er，多音节 more + 原级
the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...（越……越……）
比较级 + and + 比较级（越来越……）
倍数三种：① times as 原级 as ② times 比较级 than ③ times the 名词 of
修饰比较级：much/far/even + 比较级（强）/ a little/a bit + 比较级（弱）
两倍用 twice，三倍及以上用 three/four/... times

objectives: 掌握五步法强化版，能拆解CET四级以上难度的长难句
识别六类长难句模式并逐层分析
能独立完成真题级长难句的句法还原

config.text: CET阅读中，平均每篇有3-5个长难句——读不懂一个关键句，整段理解全偏。长难句不是词汇问题，而是句法拆解能力。

stat.label: 学生因长难句丢失阅读分

config.rule: 长难句 = 主句 + 多层从句/修饰成分的嵌套结构
config.formula: 五步法强化版：找谓语 → 定主句 → 析从句 → 理修饰 → 整句意
bullets: Step 1 找谓语：排除非谓语（doing/done/to do），找真正有时态变化的动词
Step 2 定主句：找到主句的主语和谓语，这就是句子的「骨架」
Step 3 析从句：找出所有从句（定语从句/状语从句/名词性从句），标明引导词和从句类型
Step 4 理修饰：找出介词短语、非谓语短语、插入语等修饰成分，确定它们修饰谁
Step 5 整句意：按照中文语序（定语前置、状语前置/后置）重组翻译

config.rule: 六类长难句模式——识别模式比死记语法规则更高效
config.formula: 模式 = 嵌套 | 非谓语 | 并列+从句 | 介词链 | 插入语 | 倒装+从句
bullets: 模式1 多层定语从句嵌套：先行词 + which/who + 从句 + whose/where + 内层从句
模式2 非谓语短语作状语：主句前/后挂 doing/done/to do 短语，扩展信息量
模式3 并列结构+从句：and/but 连接两个并列分句，每个分句再带从句
模式4 介词短语链：of + n + in + n + for + n 连续堆叠，造成结构模糊
模式5 插入语干扰：两个逗号之间的补充说明，可先跳过再回头看
模式6 倒装+从句混合：否定词/Only位于句首引起倒装，同时嵌套从句

config.title: 真题拆解1：多层定语从句嵌套

examples.en: The researchers, who had spent years studying the effects of pollution on marine life, published a report that warned governments about the devastating consequences of inaction.
examples.zh: 研究人员——他们花了数年研究污染对海洋生物的影响——发布了一份报告，该报告警告各国政府不作为将带来毁灭性后果。

steps.label: 找谓语
steps.detail: had spent（过去完成时，在who从句中）和 published（一般过去时，主句谓语）和 warned（过去时，在that从句中）

steps.label: 定主句
steps.detail: The researchers published a report. — 研究人员发布了一份报告。

steps.label: 析从句
steps.detail: ① who引导的非限制性定语从句修饰researchers；② that引导的定语从句修饰a report

steps.label: 理修饰
steps.detail: studying the effects of pollution on marine life（介词链：of + on）；of inaction（介词短语修饰consequences）

steps.label: 整句意
steps.detail: 主句+两个定语从句按中文语序前置，翻译如上

config.title: 真题拆解2：非谓语短语+介词链+插入语

examples.en: Having recognized the need for urgent reform, the committee — consisting of experts from various fields — proposed a series of measures designed to address the growing concerns about income inequality.
examples.zh: 在认识到迫切需要改革之后，由各领域专家组成的委员会提出了一系列旨在解决人们对收入不平等日益增长的担忧的措施。

steps.label: 找谓语
steps.detail: recognized（完成时非谓语，排除）→ proposed（主句谓语，一般过去时）→ designed（过去分词，后置定语，排除）

steps.label: 定主句
steps.detail: the committee proposed a series of measures — 委员会提出了一系列措施

steps.label: 析从句
steps.detail: 本句无从句，难度在于非谓语和修饰成分

steps.label: 理修饰
steps.detail: ① Having recognized...（现在分词完成式作原因状语）② —consisting of...—（插入语/同位语，修饰committee）③ designed to address...（过去分词短语作后置定语修饰measures）

steps.label: 整句意
steps.detail: 原因状语前置→主句→后置定语翻译为「旨在...的」

config.title: 真题拆解3：倒装+从句混合

examples.en: Not only does the study reveal that excessive screen time is linked to sleep disorders, but it also suggests that the impact is particularly severe among teenagers whose brains are still developing.
examples.zh: 这项研究不仅揭示了过度使用屏幕与睡眠障碍有关，而且还表明这种影响在那些大脑仍在发育的青少年中尤为严重。

steps.label: 找谓语
steps.detail: does reveal（倒装后主句谓语）→ is linked（在that从句中）→ suggests（but并列分句谓语）→ is（在内层that从句中）→ are（在whose从句中）

steps.label: 定主句
steps.detail: Not only does the study reveal..., but it also suggests... — 研究不仅揭示了……而且表明……

steps.label: 析从句
steps.detail: ① that excessive screen time is linked to sleep disorders（宾语从句）② that the impact is particularly severe...（宾语从句）③ whose brains are still developing（定语从句修饰teenagers）

steps.label: 理修饰
steps.detail: Not only...but also... 倒装结构；among teenagers（介词短语表范围）

steps.label: 整句意
steps.detail: 不仅……而且……结构保留，从句按中文语序翻译

config.title: 真题拆解4：并列结构+多重从句

examples.en: While some economists argue that the policy will stimulate economic growth in the short term, others contend that it may lead to inflation, which could ultimately undermine the very prosperity it was intended to create.
examples.zh: 虽然一些经济学家认为该政策将在短期内刺激经济增长，但另一些人则认为它可能导致通胀，而这种通胀最终可能破坏它原本旨在创造的繁荣。

steps.label: 找谓语
steps.detail: argue（在while从句中）→ will stimulate（在argue的宾语从句中）→ contend（在others主句中）→ may lead（在contend的宾语从句中）→ could undermine（在which定语从句中）→ was intended（在省略that的定语从句中）

steps.label: 定主句
steps.detail: others contend that... — 另一些人认为……（while引导让步状语从句为附属）

steps.label: 析从句
steps.detail: ① While...（让步状语从句）② that the policy will...（宾语从句1）③ that it may lead...（宾语从句2）④ which could undermine...（非限制性定语从句修饰inflation）⑤ it was intended to create（省略引导词的定语从句修饰prosperity）

steps.label: 理修饰
steps.detail: in the short term（时间状语）；ultimately（副词状语）；the very prosperity（very强调）

steps.label: 整句意
steps.detail: 虽然……但是…… / 认为……可能导致…… / 而……可能破坏……

config.title: 长难句模式识别
config.stem:
下面这个句子主要属于哪种长难句模式？

"It is the ability to adapt to changing circumstances, rather than raw intelligence, that determines long-term success in any field."
config.explanation: 这是 It is...that... 强调句型，强调主语 the ability to adapt to changing circumstances。rather than raw intelligence 是插入语（两个逗号之间），干扰判断。去掉 It is...that... 后句子完整：The ability...determines long-term success. 故选B。判断强调句的关键：去掉 It is/was...that/who... 后句子仍然完整。

config.title: 长难句句意理解
config.stem:
以下句子中，"which" 指代的是？

"The government implemented a new tax policy, which, according to many financial analysts, would significantly reduce the income gap between urban and rural areas."
config.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰逗号前的先行词 a new tax policy。意思是：政府实施了一项新的税收政策，根据许多金融分析师的说法，该政策将显著缩小城乡收入差距。判断技巧：which 永远指代逗号前面紧邻的核心名词（先行词），跳过插入语 according to many financial analysts 不影响判断。

config.title: 长难句拆解练习
config.stem:
将下面的长难句拆解为2-3个简单句，使句意更清晰：

原句：The professor, whose research has been widely cited in academic journals, argued that the traditional approach to education needs to be reformed, especially in developing countries where resources are limited.
steps: Step 1 找主句：The professor argued that...
Step 2 拆 whose 从句：The professor's research has been widely cited in academic journals.
Step 3 拆 that 从句：The traditional approach to education needs to be reformed.
Step 4 拆 where 从句：Resources are limited in developing countries.
Step 5 组合：His research has been widely cited. He argued that education needs reform, especially in developing countries with limited resources.
config.sampleAnswer:
① The professor's research has been widely cited in academic journals.
② The professor argued that the traditional approach to education needs to be reformed.
③ This is especially true in developing countries where resources are limited.
config.explanation: 拆解要点：① whose → 转为所有格 The professor's research；② that 从句 → 独立成句；③ where 从句 → 独立成句或用介词短语 with 代替。拆解后每句只有一个主谓结构，逻辑更清晰。

config.text: 长难句不可怕——五步法是万能钥匙，六类模式帮你快速识别题型
takeaway: 五步法强化版：找谓语→定主句→析从句→理修饰→整句意
六类模式：嵌套/非谓语/并列+从句/介词链/插入语/倒装+从句
遇到插入语先跳过——两个逗号之间的内容不影响主句结构
非谓语不是谓语——doing/done/to do不能作主句谓语
which永远指代逗号前的先行词，跳过插入语再判断

objectives: 掌握从简单句到高级句式的升级路径
熟练运用倒装句、强调句、虚拟语气等高分句式
积累20个即插即用的写作句式模板

config.text: 阅卷老师平均每篇作文看30秒——开头一个高级句式，印象分直接拉高。写作不是词汇量的比拼，是句式多样性的展现。

stat.label: 作文中建议使用的句式类型

config.rule: 基础升级路径：简单句 → 并列句 → 复合句 → 高级句式
config.formula: 升级 = 主语一致 + 动词升级 + 结构复杂化
bullets: Level 1 简单句：I think this is important.（一个主谓结构）
Level 2 并列句：I think this is important, and we should pay attention to it.（and/but连接）
Level 3 复合句：I think that this is important, which deserves our attention.（从句嵌套）
Level 4 高级句式：It is this issue that deserves our utmost attention.（强调句）

config.title: 高级句式应用：倒装句开头

examples.en: Not only 倒装
examples.zh:
普通：Technology has changed our lives, and it has also transformed education.
升级：Not only has technology changed our lives, but it has also transformed education.
examples.analysis: Not only 位于句首时，所在分句部分倒装（助动词提前）。has 提到主语 technology 前面。注意 but it has also... 后面不倒装。

examples.en: Only by 倒装
examples.zh:
普通：We can achieve success only by working hard.
升级：Only by working hard can we achieve success.
examples.analysis: Only + 状语（介词短语/副词/状语从句）位于句首时，主句部分倒装。can 提到主语 we 前面。注意：Only + 主语不倒装（Only he knows the answer. ✓）

examples.en: 否定词倒装
examples.zh:
普通：We should never ignore the importance of environmental protection.
升级：Never should we ignore the importance of environmental protection.
examples.analysis: 否定副词（Never/Rarely/Seldom/Little/Hardly）位于句首时，部分倒装。should 提到主语 we 前面。适用场景：议论文强调观点。

config.title: 高级句式应用：强调句 & 虚拟语气

examples.en: 强调句点题
examples.zh:
普通：Education plays a crucial role in personal development.
升级：It is education that plays a crucial role in personal development.
examples.analysis: It is...that... 强调句型，可以强调主语/宾语/状语。判断方法：去掉 It is 和 that 后句子仍完整。强调主语：It is education that... 强调状语：It is through education that we develop ourselves.

examples.en: 虚拟语气议论文
examples.zh:
普通：If we do not take action now, the situation will get worse.
升级：If we were to take no action now, the situation would get worse. / Were we to take no action now, the situation would get worse.
examples.analysis: 与现在/将来事实相反的虚拟：if + 过去式/were to do → would + do。倒装省略if更高级：Were we to... 代替 If we were to...。适用场景：分析问题、提出假设。

examples.en: 非谓语短语作伴随状语
examples.zh:
普通：People are more aware of health issues, and they exercise more regularly.
升级：Being more aware of health issues, people exercise more regularly.
examples.analysis: 现在分词短语作原因/伴随状语，让两个简单句合为一个复合结构。过去分词：Compared with the past, people are more aware of health issues. 完成式：Having realized the importance of health, people exercise more regularly.

config.rule: 过渡句式是文章逻辑的「骨架」——连接观点、递进论述、总结全文
config.formula: 过渡句式 = 开头引题 + 中间递进 + 结尾总结
bullets: 引出话题：It goes without saying that... / There is no denying that... / It is universally acknowledged that...
递进论述：Not only...but also... / What is more... / Furthermore, it is worth noting that...
强调观点：What matters most is that... / It is of great importance to... / Nothing is more important than...
对比转折：While it is true that..., it is also the case that... / However, this does not mean that...
总结全文：Taking all these factors into consideration, we may safely draw the conclusion that...

config.title: 20个即插即用写作句式模板
rows: It goes without saying that + 主句

config.title: 句式升级练习1
config.stem:
将下面的简单句升级为高级句式（至少使用一种高级结构）：

原句：Many students use smartphones in class, and this affects their learning.
steps: Step 1 分析原句：两个简单句用 and 连接，结构平淡
Step 2 选择升级方向：强调句 / 非谓语 / 倒装
Step 3 尝试强调句：It is the widespread use of smartphones in class that negatively affects students' learning.
Step 4 尝试非谓语：Using smartphones in class, many students find their learning affected.
Step 5 选择最佳版本
config.sampleAnswer:
推荐升级版：
① Not only do many students use smartphones in class, but this habit also significantly impairs their learning.（倒装+递进）
② It is the excessive use of smartphones in class that negatively affects students' academic performance.（强调句）
③ Using smartphones frequently in class, students often find it difficult to concentrate on their studies.（非谓语作状语）
config.explanation: 升级要点：① 把普通并列句改为 Not only...but also... 倒装结构；② 用强调句突出核心问题（excessive use）；③ 用非谓语开头，使句子更紧凑。三种方式都是加分项，建议作文中至少用1-2种。

config.title: 句式升级练习2
config.stem:
将下面的简单句升级为高级句式（至少使用两种高级结构）：

原句：We should protect the environment. If we don't protect it, we will face serious consequences.
steps: Step 1 分析原句：两个简单句+一个条件句，全是基础结构
Step 2 选择升级方向：强调句 + 虚拟语气倒装 / 非谓语 + 倒装
Step 3 虚拟语气升级：If we were to neglect environmental protection, we would face...
Step 4 省if倒装：Were we to neglect..., we would face...
Step 5 强调句升级：It is environmental protection that we should prioritize.
config.sampleAnswer:
推荐升级版：
① It is environmental protection that deserves our utmost attention. Were we to neglect it, we would face devastating consequences.（强调句+虚拟语气倒装）
② Not only should we protect the environment, but we must also realize that failure to do so would lead to irreversible damage.（倒装+虚拟语气）
config.explanation: 升级要点：① It is...that... 强调句开头直接点题；② Were we to... 省略if的虚拟倒装，比 If we don't 高级很多；③ Not only should we... 倒装句引出双重观点。一篇作文中能组合使用2-3种高级结构，句式多样性直接拉满。

config.text: 写作高分 = 句式多样性 + 逻辑清晰——不需要全用高级句式，但至少用2-3种
takeaway: 升级路径：简单句→并列句→复合句→高级句式
倒装三件套：Not only.../ Only by.../ 否定词开头
强调句万能公式：It is...that...（去掉后句子仍完整）
虚拟语气倒装：Were we to... / Had it not been for... 省略if更高级
模板是工具不是拐杖——理解结构后灵活变通

objectives: 掌握完形填空TOP10语法考点的解题策略
了解翻译和写作中的高频语法难点
建立写作语法自查清单，减少低级语法错误

config.text: 完形填空10分，翻译15分，写作15分——语法在这三大题型中占据半壁江山。考前系统梳理考点，比盲目刷题效率高得多。

config.title: 完形填空语法考点 TOP 10
rows: 分析空格在句中的成分（主/谓/宾/定/状），确定需要什么词性
找时间线索词和上下文动词时态，保持时态一致
doing(主动/进行) / done(被动/完成) / to do(目的/将来)，看逻辑关系
it/that/those/one替代规则：it=同名同物；that=同名异物；those=复数同名异物；one=泛指替代
动词+介词 / 形容词+介词 / 名词+介词，靠积累+语境判断
看主语是动作执行者还是承受者，确定用主动还是被动
if条件句 / suggest+that / It is important that... → should + do
否定词/Only+状语位于句首→部分倒装，注意识别倒装标志
It is...that/who...，判断方法：去掉后句子仍完整

config.rule: 代词指代是完形填空的高频陷阱——四个替代词各有严格的使用规则
config.formula: it = 同名同物 | that = 同名异物(单数) | those = 同名异物(复数) | one = 泛指替代
bullets: it：指代上文提到的同一个事物（同名同物）。The weather here is colder than it was yesterday.（it = the weather here，同一事物）
that：指代同类但不同的事物（同名异物），常用于比较结构，特指。The population of China is larger than that of Japan.（that = the population，但中国的不是日本的）
those：that 的复数形式。The students in this class are more active than those in that class.
one：泛指替代同类的某一个（不特指）。I don't have a pen. Can you lend me one?（one = a pen，随便哪支都行）
指代一致性检查：代词必须与所指名词在数（单/复数）和性（人称）上一致

config.rule: 翻译和写作各有高频语法难点——考前针对性准备
config.formula:
翻译难点 = 从句处理 + 非谓语转换 + 被动选择 + 长定语
写作检查 = 时态 + 主谓一致 + 碎句 + 代词指代
bullets: 翻译：从句处理——英语从句多后置，中文需前置或拆分（定语从句→「……的」前置 / 宾语从句可保留语序）
翻译：非谓语转换——英文非谓语短语→中文可译为并列句或独立句（Having done...→「在……之后，……」）
翻译：被动语态选择——英文常用被动→中文倾向主动（It is widely believed that...→「人们普遍认为……」）
翻译：长定语处理——多重前置定语在中文中应拆分为多个短句，避免定语过长
写作：时态一致性——同一语境不乱跳时态
写作：主谓一致——注意there be / 介词短语做主语 / each/every 等特殊主语
写作：碎句和粘连句——两个完整句子不能仅用逗号连接（需and/but/分号或改为从句）
写作：代词指代清晰——this/that/these/those 使用时必须有明确的指代对象

config.title: 代词指代判断
config.stem: 完形填空中，下列哪句的代词使用正确？

options.text: The cost of living in Beijing is higher than that in Shanghai.
The cost of living in Beijing is higher than it in Shanghai.
The cost of living in Beijing is higher than one in Shanghai.
The cost of living in Beijing is higher than those in Shanghai.

config.explanation: A 正确：that 指代同名异物（北京的cost vs 上海的cost），that = the cost，是CET完形填空最常考的代词用法。B 错：it = 同名同物，等于说北京的生活成本比北京自己的高，逻辑矛盾。C 错：one = 泛指（随便一个），而这里是特指上海的生活成本，应用that。D 错：those = 复数，cost 是单数不可数名词，应用that。

config.title: 完形填空语法综合
config.stem:
"By the time the doctor arrived at the hospital, the patient ___ (examine) by the nurses and ___ (take) to the operating room."

四个空格分别填什么？

options.text: had been examined / had been taken
has been examined / has been taken

config.explanation: By the time + 过去时（arrived）→ 主句用过去完成时。同时病人是「被」检查和「被」带到手术室，所以用被动语态。had been examined = 过去完成时被动（在医生到达之前已被检查完毕），had been taken = 过去完成时被动（已被带到手术室）。B 用一般过去时无法表达「先于arrived完成」的先后关系。C 用现在完成时与时态不匹配。D 用了主动语态，逻辑错误。

config.title: 写作语法纠错填空
config.stem:
下面的写作句子各有语法错误，找出并改正：

1. One of the students {{1}} (have) passed the exam.
2. Not only he {{2}} (finish) the task, but he also helped others.
3. It is the ability to communicate {{3}} (that/which) makes a person successful.
4. Everyone should be aware of {{4}} (they/their) responsibility for the environment.

blanks.hint: One of + 复数名词 → 单数
Everyone单数但代词用their（性别中立）

config.explanation: ① One of + 复数名词作主语 → 谓语用单数 has（不是have）。这是主谓一致的经典考点。② Not only 位于句首 → 部分倒装：Not only has he finished / Not only did he finish（不是 Not only he finished）。③ 强调句型固定用 that（It is...that...），不用which。强调句去掉It is...that后句子完整：The ability to communicate makes a person successful. ✓ ④ Everyone 语法上为单数，但现代英语中代词用 their（性别中立），比 his or her 更自然。CET考试中 this/that 指代要明确、代词与名词数要一致。

config.text: CET语法 = 完形填空（词性/时态/非谓语/代词）+ 翻译（从句/被动/长定语）+ 写作（时态/主谓一致/碎句）
takeaway: 完形TOP5：词性判断、时态一致、非谓语、从句引导词、代词指代
代词指代四兄弟：it(同名同物) / that(同名异物) / those(复数) / one(泛指)
翻译核心：英语重结构→中文重意义，长句需拆分、被动转主动
写作检查清单：时态一致 / 主谓一致 / 碎句粘连句 / 代词指代清晰
考前重点：非谓语逻辑关系 + 代词that/it区别 + 强调句判断方法

Fill in the missing words based on the scene context.

config.stem: 判断正误：听到 "assignment" 和 "deadline" 时，对话一定发生在校园场景。

audio.transcript: We need to finish this assignment before the deadline. The client is expecting the final design by Monday.

config.explanation: assignment 和 deadline 在校园和工作场景都可能出现。本题中 client / final design 明确指向工作场景，说明不能仅凭一两个词判断，需要综合多处信号词

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 一词跨多场景
"assignment" 既可指学生作业，也可指工作任务；"schedule" 在校园排课和公司排班中都出现。**必须结合 2 个以上信号词交叉验证**，不能听到一个词就下结论。

### 坑 2: 场景词被同义替换
"prescription" 可能被替换为 "the doctor gave me some medicine"；"enrollment" 可能变成 "sign up for classes"。**听到描述性短语时要快速还原为场景关键词**。

### 坑 3: 场景混合干扰
长对话可能先在 A 场景开头，再转到 B 场景讨论核心问题。例如先在电话里聊工作（场景 A），然后约同事去医院探望（场景 B）。**题目问的是核心场景，需要抓住主要讨论话题**。

config.stem: Listen to the dialogue and identify the main scene.

transcript.text: Hi Sarah, I saw your name on the volunteer list for the community health fair this Saturday.
transcript.speaker: M

transcript.text: Oh yes! I'm helping with the blood pressure screening booth. My nursing professor encouraged us to participate.
transcript.speaker: F

transcript.text: That's great. I'm coordinating the campus shuttle to the community center. We still have a few seats left.
transcript.speaker: M

transcript.text: Perfect, I'll sign up. Should I bring my stethoscope or will the clinic provide the equipment?

config.explanation: 虽然出现 nursing professor / campus shuttle（校园信号词）和 blood pressure / stethoscope（医院信号词），但核心话题是 community health fair（社区健康义诊）的筹备协调。干扰项 A 只抓了医院词、B 只抓了校园词、D 只抓了 nursing，均以偏概全。本题难度在于三类场景词交织，需综合判断主要讨论话题

config.text: 校园工作和医院，信号词先锁定；场景对了答案准
takeaway: 场景词是长对话的入口，3 秒内锁定场景
三大场景各有 5-8 个高频信号词，反复听练

config.title: 陷阱判断：听写中的误判
config.stem: 以下说法是否正确：听写时如果某句第 1 遍没听清，应该立即回放该句反复听，直到听清再往下走。

audio.transcript: When doing dictation, if you miss a sentence on the first listen, you should replay it immediately and keep trying until you get it right before moving on.

config.explanation: 这是常见误区。正确做法是先完成整段听写（最多 3 遍），再统一对照原文。反复卡在单句会导致后面内容全部漏听，且脱离语境后更难推测连读省略的部分。

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 连读吞音导致漏词

口语中 of、to、and 等虚词常被弱读甚至吞掉，如 kind of 听成 kinda，going to 听成 gonna。听写时遇到语速快的句子，先抓实义词，再根据语法补虚词。

### 坑 2: 音近词混淆拼写

convene / convince、principal / principle、affect / effect 等音近词是听写重灾区。解决办法：默写后必须对照原文逐字母核对，把易混词对记入专门的辨析本。

### 坑 3: 复数和时态尾巴丢失

-s、-ed、-ing 等词尾在快速语流中几乎听不到，但语法上不可或缺。听写完要检查主谓一致、时态连贯，用语法知识反推缺失的词尾。

config.title: 递进难题：长句精听推理

用数据反驳了远程办公低效的观点
对远程办公持中立态度

card_shared_listening_homophone.title: 同音/近音词 8 组辨析

objectives: 记住 8 组高频同音/近音词：their/there/they're, hear/here, weather/whether 等
听 audio 例句辨别
通过选择题巩固

config.text: 四级听力每套卷至少出现 2-3 道同音/近音词干扰题，稍不留神就会选错

config.title: 同音/近音词辨析规则
config.rule: 听力中遇到发音相近的词，必须靠上下文语义判断，不能只靠听
bullets: their(他们的) / there(那里) / they're(他们是) —— 读音完全相同，靠语法位置区分
hear(听见) / here(这里) —— 辅音 h 后接不同元音
weather(天气) / whether(是否) —— 注意 /wɛðər/ vs /wɛðər/，语义完全不同
effect(效果) / affect(影响) —— 名词 vs 动词为主
accept(接受) / except(除了) —— /əkˈsɛpt/ vs /ɪkˈsɛpt/
advice(建议,名词) / advise(建议,动词) —— 尾音 /s/ vs /z/
loose(松的) / lose(丢失) —— /luːs/ vs /luːz/
quite(相当) / quiet(安静的) —— 重音位置和元音不同

transcript.speaker: M

transcript.speaker: F

transcript.speaker: M

transcript.speaker: F

examples.en: The manager's advice was to advise the team more carefully.
examples.zh: 经理的建议是更仔细地指导团队。
examples.analysis: 易错点: advice 和 advise 发音极近，但 advice 是名词(/ədˈvaɪs/)，advise 是动词(/ədˈvaɪz/)。听时先判断词性位置：前面有 manager's 修饰，所以第一个是名词 advice；to 后面需要动词，所以第二个是 advise。

config.title: 巩固练习
config.stem: I wonder _____ we should go to the beach. 根据上下文，空格应填哪个词?

audio.transcript: I wonder whether we should go to the beach.

config.explanation: "whether we should go" 表示"是否应该去"，是 whether 引导的宾语从句；weather 是"天气"，语法上说不通。

config.title: 信号词捕捉
config.stem: 听力原文: "I can't {{1}} the difference between the two words." 和 "Please come {{2}}, I need to show you something."

audio.transcript: I can't hear the difference between the two words. Please come here, I need to show you something.

config.explanation: hear 是动词"听见"，后接宾语 the difference；here 是副词"这里"，come here 表示"来这里"。两句连读时发音非常接近，需靠语法位置判断。

config.title: 陷阱判断
config.stem: 听力原文: "She lost the loose screw under the bed." 判断：此处 loose 和 lose 都是动词。

audio.transcript: She lost the loose screw under the bed.

config.explanation: lost 是动词 lose 的过去式，表示"丢失"；loose 是形容词"松动的"，修饰 screw（螺丝）。两个词拼写和发音都相近（/luːz/ vs /luːs/），但词性和功能完全不同，考生易误以为两个都是动词。

config.title: 递进难题
config.stem: 听力原文: "The board decided to effect a new policy that would affect the entire department. Their main concern was whether the changes would take effect by January." 这段话中 effect 出现了两次，分别是什么词性?

audio.transcript: The board decided to effect a new policy that would affect the entire department. Their main concern was whether the changes would take effect by January.

options.text: 第一次是动词，第二次是名词
第一次是名词，第二次是动词

config.explanation: effect 作动词时表示"实施、使生效"，effect a new policy = 实施新政策；take effect 是固定短语，effect 是名词"效果/生效"。affect 始终是动词"影响"。三个词在长句中连续出现，听时需逐个判断语法角色，不能凭第一印象下结论。

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 只靠听音选词
同音词（如 their/there/they're）发音完全一样，听 100 遍也分不出来。正确做法是听完整句，根据语法位置判断：所有格用 their，地点副词用 there，缩写用 they're。

### 坑 2: 忽略词性线索
accept/except、advice/advise 这类近音词，词性不同意味着句法位置不同。听到动词位置（to ___ / will ___）就排除名词形式，听到冠词或所有格后面就排除动词形式。

### 坑 3: 长句中丢失语境
短句辨析容易做对，但长句中多个近音词连续出现时（如 effect...affect...effect），考生容易混乱。解决方法是听完后先回忆整句意思，再逐词匹配语义。

config.title: 总结
config.text: 同音近音靠语境，语法语义是关键
takeaway: 同音/近音词听力中无法靠发音区分，必须依赖上下文语义
多读例句培养语感，考试时快速判断词性与语法位置
8 组高频词反复听练，形成条件反射

card_shared_listening_linking.title: 连读 / 失爆 / 弱读三大语流现象

objectives: 识别三大语流现象：连读 / 失爆 / 弱读
听 audio 例段感受语流变化
通过选择题练习语流辨别

config.text: 为什么 native speaker 说话你总是跟不上？因为他们会把单词「粘」在一起读。

config.rule: 连读：辅音+元音相连；失爆：爆破音只做口型不发声；弱读：功能词轻化缩音
bullets: 连读 Linking：前词尾辅音 + 后词首元音 → 自然拼接，如 not at all → /nɒ-tæ-tɔːl/
失爆 Loss of Explosion：/p/ /b/ /t/ /d/ /k/ /g/ 在词尾遇辅音时只留阻塞不释放，如 good boy → goo( )boy
弱读 Reduction：虚词（a, to, for, and…）在句中轻读成 /ə/ 或与前后词融合，如 and → /ən/、to → /tə/

I want to go and get it.

transcript.text: Notice how 'want to' becomes 'wanna' — this is linking and reduction.
transcript.speaker: F

transcript.speaker: M

transcript.speaker: F

transcript.speaker: M

transcript.speaker: F

examples.en: I picked up a cup of coffee on my way to work.
examples.zh: 我在上班路上买了一杯咖啡。
examples.analysis: 易错点: 很多同学把每个词都清楚地读出来 /aɪ pɪkt ʌp ə kʌp ɒv kɒfi/，但真实语速下 'picked up' 会连读成 /pɪktʌp/，'cup of' 连读成 /kʌpəv/，'on my' 弱读成 /ən maɪ/。如果逐词辨音，很容易跟不上节奏丢掉关键信息。

config.stem: 在 "She's a good girl and works hard" 中，'good girl' 最可能产生哪种语流现象？
config.explanation: good 的尾音 /d/ 是爆破音，后接辅音 /g/（girl）时只做舌位阻塞而不释放气流，属于失爆。

config.stem: 听音频填空：'Not at {{1}}, I can't get {{2}} of it.'（音频中三处语流现象）

audio.transcript: Not at all, I can't get enough of it.

blanks.hint: get 和 of 之间有连读

config.explanation: 'Not at all' 中 not→at 产生连读 /nɒtæt/，at→all 也连读；'get enough of' 中 get→enough 连读、enough→of 连读。整句语流密集，初听容易只捕捉到零散单词。

config.stem: 判断：'I want to go' 在正常语速下，'want to' 一定会被读成 /wɒnə/（wanna），不存在例外。
config.explanation: 虽然 wanna 是极常见的弱读+连读形式，但在强调语气或放慢语速时，说话者可能刻意读清楚 /wɒnt tuː/。考试听力中两种读法都可能出现，不能假定 100% 是 wanna。

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 把连读词当生词
'turn off' 连读后听起来像 /tɜːr-nɒf/，很多同学以为是一个没见过的新词。应对：熟悉高频动词+介词搭配的连读形式，如 pick up / look at / come on。

### 坑 2: 失爆后以为没说完
'big cat' 中 /g/ 失爆，听起来像 /bɪ kæt/，容易误以为少了一个音节。应对：练习识别 6 个爆破音在词尾遇到辅音时的「卡顿感」。

### 坑 3: 弱读词被完全忽略
'and' 弱读成 /ən/ 甚至 /n/ 后，很多同学完全听不见，导致漏听并列信息。应对：对 a / an / the / to / for / and / or 等功能词建立弱读敏感度。

config.stem: 听对话回答问题：男士说 'I should have called you back, but I got caught up in a meeting.' 这句话中，哪个部分最容易因为语流现象被漏听？

audio.transcript: I should have called you back, but I got caught up in a meeting.

options.text: 'should have' 被弱读成 /ʃʊdəv/，可能被听成一个词
'called you' 连读成 /kɔːldʒuː/，不容易分辨
'caught up in a' 多处连读+弱读，节奏密集难以拆分
整句没有明显语流变化，都能听清

config.explanation: 'caught up in a' 是本句语流最密集的段落：caught→up 连读 /kɔːtʌp/，up→in 连读 /ʌpɪn/，in→a 弱读成 /ɪnə/，四个词压缩在极短时间内。A/B 虽然也有语流现象，但音节少、节奏相对清晰；D 完全错误——整句语流变化非常密集。

config.text: 辅连爆失弱轻读，语流三板斧：连读拼、失爆留、弱读缩
takeaway: 连读：前辅音 + 后元音 → 拼在一起读
失爆：爆破音遇辅音 → 只阻塞不发声
弱读：虚词轻化 → /ə/ 或缩音
高频搭配（pick up / turn off / got caught up）要反复听形成语流记忆
遇到「听不清」先判断是哪种语流现象，不要盲目猜测词义

objectives: 识别隐性否定：barely / hardly / scarcely / seldom

config.title: 听力中的隐形炸弹
config.text: 听力考试中约 30% 的态度判断题藏有否定陷阱：barely、hardly 这类词听起来不像否定，却是拿分关键。

config.title: 否定陷阱识别规则
config.rule: barely / hardly / scarcely / seldom / rarely / never 都是否定词，听到即反转态度
bullets: barely = 几乎不，hardly = 几乎不，scarcely = 几乎不
seldom = 很少，rarely = 很少，never = 从不
双重否定 = 肯定：not uncommon = 很常见，not impossible = 有可能
否定词前置 → 后面内容是真实态度

正确理解: 对大多数学生来说考试还算可以

config.title: 陷阱判断
config.stem: 听音频判断对错："The speaker thinks the movie was terrible."

audio.transcript: Well, the movie was not that bad actually. I could barely keep my eyes open though, but that was because I was tired, not because it was boring.

config.explanation: 说话者说"not that bad"（双重否定 = 还行），且后面解释困是因为累而不是电影无聊，说明他觉得电影还行，不认为terrible。易误判原因：只听到 barely keep eyes open 就以为态度消极。

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 把 barely/hardly 当肯定词

barely 和 hardly 发音轻、含义模糊，听起来像 "beer" 或 "hard"，容易误以为是肯定。记住：看到 -ly 结尾 + ba-/har- 开头 = 否定。

### 坑 2: 双重否定只扫到一个 not

听到 "not uncommon" 时只注意到 not，以为是"不常见"。正确做法：遇到 not 后面紧跟否定词（un-/im-/dis-），立刻反应为双重否定 = 肯定。

### 坑 3: 否定词后跟转折 but

"It was not bad, but..." 这种结构中 but 后面往往才是真实态度。如果只听到 not bad 就选"还行"，可能会掉进 but 后面的反转陷阱。

config.title: 递进挑战
config.stem: What does the woman imply about the new policy?

audio.transcript: To be honest, the new policy is not unreasonable. I wouldn't say it's impossible to adapt to, but it's certainly not what I'd call straightforward. You can barely find anyone who fully supports it though.

options.text: The policy is reasonable but hard to implement
The policy is straightforward and well-supported
Nobody has adapted to the policy yet

config.explanation: "not unreasonable" 双重否定 = 有道理；"not impossible to adapt" = 可以适应；但 "not straightforward" = 不简单；"barely find anyone who supports" = 几乎没人支持。综合来看：政策合理但执行困难。干扰项 A 只扫到一个 not，C 误把 not unreasonable 当否定，D 偷换 "barely support" 为 "adapted"。

config.title: 要点回顾
config.text: 听到否定词，先反转再判断；双重否定等于肯定
takeaway: barely / hardly / scarcely / seldom / rarely / never 都是否定词
双重否定 = 肯定：not uncommon = 很常见

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 干扰项反向诱导
出题人常把容易混淆的两个数字都放进对话，如 "fifty, not fifteen"。如果只听后半句就容易选错。**策略：听到纠正句型 'not X, but Y' 时，答案是 Y。**

### 坑 2: 连读吞音模糊边界
数字与前后词连读时（如 "at six fifteen" 中 at six 融合），边界变模糊。**策略：提前预判数字出现位置，集中听数字的重音模式。**

### 坑 3: 年份 / 价格 / 时间三种数字格式混出
同一篇对话可能既有价格（$15/$50）又有时间（6:15/6:50），容易张冠李戴。**策略：听数字时同步记笔记，标注是价格还是时间。**

-ty 重音在前、元音短 → 几十
遇到拿不准就听重音位置 + 元音长度
纠正句型 'not X, but Y' 答案是 Y

config.title: 同义替换判断
config.stem: 阅读以下句子："I'm afraid the hotel rooms are quite costly during the holiday season." 以下哪个选项与原句意思最接近？

options.text: The hotel rooms are cheap during holidays.
The hotel rooms are expensive during holidays.
The hotel rooms are unavailable during holidays.
The hotel rooms are comfortable during holidays.

config.explanation: costly = expensive，都是"昂贵的"意思。A 是反义，C 是无关替换（unavailable），D 也是无关词。

config.title: 信号词捕捉
config.stem: The company decided to {{1}} the project because of budget cuts. They also need to {{2}} the number of staff.

audio.transcript: The company decided to abandon the project because of budget cuts. They also need to reduce the number of staff.

config.explanation: abandon = cancel = scrap = terminate 都表示放弃或取消项目；reduce = cut = decrease = lower 都表示削减人数。同义替换不仅出现在选项中，填空题也会考你对多个近义词的掌握。

config.title: 陷阱判断
config.stem: 听力原文："The assignment is due next Monday, but you can hand it in earlier if you want." 题目选项写着 "The deadline has been extended." 请判断该选项是否正确。

audio.transcript: The assignment is due next Monday, but you can hand it in earlier if you want.

config.explanation: 这是典型的同义替换陷阱！原文说截止日期是下周一，可以提前交——但 "extended" 表示延期，与原文意思相反。干扰项利用 "earlier" 和 "extended" 的时间关系混淆考生。正确理解：deadline 没变，只是允许提前交。

config.title: 同义替换常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1：形近义不同
resign（辞职）≠ re-sign（续约），affect（影响）≠ effect（效果）。听力中形近词极易混淆，必须结合语境判断。

### 坑 2：反义干扰
原文说 "not expensive"，选项给 "cheap" 是同义替换没错，但如果给 "costly" 就是反义陷阱。听到否定词时要特别留意选项方向。

### 坑 3：部分重合
原文提到 "improve the service and reduce the price"，选项只说 "improve the price"——看似有原词，实则张冠李戴。同义替换考的是整体语义匹配，不能只抓单个词。

config.title: 递进挑战
config.stem: 听力原文："Initially, we planned to outsource the marketing campaign, but after reviewing the proposals, we figured it would be more feasible to handle it in-house." What does the speaker mean?

audio.transcript: Initially, we planned to outsource the marketing campaign, but after reviewing the proposals, we figured it would be more feasible to handle it in-house.

options.text: They will hire an external agency for marketing.
They decided to do the marketing work themselves.
They are still reviewing the outsourcing proposals.
They think outsourcing is the more practical option.

config.explanation: 这道题有两层同义替换：① outsource → external agency（A 选项是原计划，不是最终决定）；② in-house → handle it themselves → do the work themselves（B 才是正确答案）。注意转折词 but 后面才是真实决定。D 是反向干扰，feasible = practical 但方向搞反了。

config.title: 本卡小结
config.text: 听到关键词，脑中闪同义，选项找匹配
takeaway: 同义替换是四级听力最常见的出题手法
积累高频替换对：postpone=delay, cancel=call off, expensive=costly
听到原文 → 联想同义词 → 匹配选项，三步完成
警惕三大陷阱：形近词、反义干扰、部分重合
转折词 but/however 后的内容往往是答案所在

config.title: 常见 3 个坑
config.markdown:
### 坑 1: 只听转折前就选答案
很多同学听到第一句正面评价就直接选，忽略了后面的 but / however。正确做法是**等到转折词出现后再判断**。

### 坑 2: 混淆 actually 和 in fact 的语气
actually 常用来纠正前文或引入出人意料的真相，语气比 but 更强。听到 actually 要格外警惕，后面往往是**真正的考点**。

### 坑 3: 被部分正确的选项迷惑
命题人喜欢用转折前的正面评价 + 转折后的部分关键词拼成干扰项。遇到两个选项都提到原文词汇时，选**转折后表达真实态度**的那个。

config.title: 状语从句类型
config.rule: 状语从句由从属连词引导，修饰主句的时间、地点、原因等，识别关键在于抓住连接词

让步：although / though / even though / while

config.title: 高亮主干与状语
config.text: While scientists were analyzing the data, the new policy was announced because officials feared public panic.

config.title: 状语从句 3 大陷阱
config.markdown:
### 1. 让步与原因混淆
短例: "Since he was ill, he stayed home." — Since 可表原因也可表时间，此处是原因不是时间。遇到 since 先看语境再判断。

### 2. 从句当主句
短例: "If you study hard, you will pass." 误把 If 从句当主句。去掉 If 从句，真正主句是 "you will pass"。

### 3. 多层嵌套漏读
短例: "When the teacher arrived, because it was raining, the students who had been waiting outside rushed in." 三层修饰嵌套，阅读时需逐层拆解而非一口气读完。

config.title: 推理判断难题
config.stem: "Although the company reported strong quarterly earnings, analysts remained cautious because the growth was primarily driven by a one-time government subsidy rather than sustainable demand." What can be inferred about the analysts' attitude?

options.text: They are optimistic about the company's long-term prospects
They doubt the sustainability of the reported growth
They believe government subsidies will continue
They think the earnings report is inaccurate

config.explanation: 句中 Although 引导让步状语从句（强季度收益），主句分析师态度谨慎；because 引导原因状语从句解释谨慎原因：增长靠一次性政府补贴而非可持续需求。因此推断分析师质疑增长的可持续性，选 B。A 与 cautious 矛盾，C 文中未提补贴延续，D 报告数据本身无误。

config.source: When the results were published after the long-awaited review, many researchers who had contributed to the study expressed disappointment because the findings contradicted their initial hypothesis.

reference: researchers expressed disappointment
Many researchers expressed disappointment
rubric: 保留主语 researchers（可带修饰词 many）
保留核心谓语 expressed
保留宾语 disappointment
去掉 When 引导的时间状语从句
去掉 because 引导的原因状语从句
