config.taskDescription: 将以下邀请信改写为高分版本，要求：① 至少使用 1 个连接词（furthermore / moreover / in addition）；② 至少 1 个高级词替换（如 honor / cordially / esteemed）；③ 开头结尾使用标准套话
reference:
Dear Mr. Wang,

On behalf of our school, I am writing to cordially invite you to deliver a speech at our annual academic festival. Furthermore, your expertise in artificial intelligence would be invaluable to our students' development.

We would be honored if you could accept this invitation. Thank you for your consideration, and I look forward to your favorable reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
rubric: 含连接词（furthermore/moreover/in addition）
至少 1 个高级词替换（cordially/esteem/honor 等）
开头结尾均使用标准应用文套话
语气正式礼貌，无口语化表达
config.explanation: 进阶改写在简版基础上增加两个得分点：① 连接词（Furthermore）让逻辑更连贯；② 高级词（cordially、invaluable、esteemed）提升词汇多样性分。开头用 On behalf of + I am writing to 双套话叠加，结尾用 Thank you for your consideration 收束，形成完整高分框架。

config.title: 递进：识别合格应用文开头
config.stem: 以下哪个开头最符合正式应用文（如申请信/邀请信）的写作规范？

options.text: Hello! I want to join your club because I think it is very good.
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for membership in your esteemed club.
Hi there, I am interested in your club and want to know more about it.
To whom it may concern: I hope you can let me join your club, thanks.

config.explanation: B 选项符合三要素：① 正式称呼 Dear Sir or Madam；② 标准套话 I am writing to + 目的；③ 正式用词 esteemed。A 用 Hello + want 太口语；C 用 Hi there 非正式；D 虽用正式称呼但 I hope you can let me 表达不地道，且 thanks 结尾过于随意。

config.title: 套话速记口诀
config.text: 开头三件宝：写信目的、身份介绍、礼貌邀请；结尾三件宝：期待回复、感谢考虑、诚挚祝福
takeaway: 开头套话：I am writing to / I would like to / On behalf of
结尾套话：Looking forward to / Your prompt reply would be appreciated / Thank you for your consideration
根据场景选择合适套话，注意正式与非正式语气区别

card_shared_writing_scenario_bodies.title: 议论文主体段·5 大场景模板包

objectives: 按 5 大场景给主体段公式：观点表态（让步驳论）/ 现象原因（归因分析）/ 利弊权衡（双面论证）/ 建议方案（问题方案）/ 比较选择（A vs B）
每场景 1 套主体段三件套（论点 + 论据 + 论证）+ 高分句式
学会按题目场景挑对应主体段公式

config.text: 议论文主体段写不出？因为你没分清题目属于哪个场景！5 大场景 × 对应公式 = 主体段不再卡壳。

config.rule: 先判断题目场景，再套对应公式：论点句 → 论据展开 → 论证收束
config.formula: 主体段 = 论点(1句) + 论据(2-3句) + 论证(1句)
bullets: 场景① 观点表态（让步驳论）: 让步对方 → 转折反驳 → 举例强化
场景② 现象原因（归因分析）: 提出现象 → 分析原因1+2 → 总结影响
场景③ 利弊权衡（双面论证）: 优点展开 → 转折缺点 → 综合评判
场景④ 建议方案（问题方案）: 指出问题 → 提出方案 → 预期效果
场景⑤ 比较选择（A vs B）: 表明倾向 → 理由1 + 理由2 → 让步补充

examples.en: Admittedly, online learning offers great flexibility. However, it cannot replace face-to-face interaction in terms of building social skills and deep understanding. For instance, many students report feeling isolated during online courses, which hinders their overall development.
examples.zh: 诚然，线上学习提供了极大的灵活性。然而，在培养社交能力和深度理解方面，它无法取代面对面互动。例如，许多学生反映在线课程期间感到孤立，这阻碍了他们的全面发展。
examples.analysis:
场景① 观点表态（让步驳论）
论点: 承认灵活性 → 转折：无法取代面对面
论据: 学生反映孤立
论证: 阻碍全面发展

steps.label: 论点
steps.detail: 让步(Admittedly...flexibility) + 转折(However...replace)

steps.label: 论据
steps.detail: 举例(for instance...isolated)

steps.label: 论证
steps.detail: 收束影响(which hinders...development)

examples.en: The popularity of short videos can be attributed to two main factors. First, they cater to people's fragmented leisure time. Second, their algorithm-driven recommendation system keeps users engaged by delivering highly personalized content.
examples.zh: 短视频的流行可归因于两个主要因素。首先，它们迎合了人们碎片化的休闲时间。其次，其算法驱动的推荐系统通过高度个性化的内容让用户持续沉浸。
examples.analysis:
场景② 现象原因（归因分析）
论点: 流行可归因于两个因素
论据: 原因1(碎片化时间) + 原因2(算法推荐)
论证: 个性化内容留住用户

steps.label: 论点
steps.detail: 提出现象 + 归因预告(can be attributed to)

steps.label: 论据
steps.detail: 原因1(First...fragmented) + 原因2(Second...algorithm)

steps.label: 论证
steps.detail: 收束效果(keeps users engaged)

examples.en: Working from home has notable advantages, including flexible schedules and no commuting time. Nevertheless, it blurs the boundary between work and personal life, often leading to burnout. On balance, a hybrid model may offer the best of both worlds.
examples.zh: 在家办公有显著优势，包括灵活的作息和零通勤时间。然而，它模糊了工作与生活的界限，往往导致职业倦怠。综合来看，混合办公模式或许能兼顾两者。
examples.analysis:
场景③ 利弊权衡（双面论证）
论点: 优点展开(flexible, no commuting)
论据: 缺点(blurs boundary → burnout)
论证: 综合评判(hybrid model)

steps.label: 论点
steps.detail: 优点(notable advantages...schedules and commuting)

steps.label: 论据
steps.detail: 转折缺点(Nevertheless...burnout)

steps.label: 论证
steps.detail: 综合评判(On balance...both worlds)

examples.en: Air pollution in major cities has reached alarming levels. To tackle this issue, governments should impose stricter emission standards on factories and promote the use of public transportation. These measures, if properly enforced, would significantly improve air quality within a few years.
examples.zh: 大城市的空气污染已达到令人担忧的水平。为解决这一问题，政府应出台更严格的工厂排放标准并推广公共交通。如果执行得当，这些措施将在数年内显著改善空气质量。
examples.analysis:
场景④ 建议方案（问题方案）
论点: 问题(alarming levels)
论据: 方案1(排放标准) + 方案2(公共交通)
论证: 预期效果(improve within years)

steps.label: 论点
steps.detail: 指出问题(air pollution...alarming)

steps.label: 论据
steps.detail: 方案1(stricter standards) + 方案2(public transport)

steps.label: 论证
steps.detail: 预期效果(would significantly improve)

examples.en: When it comes to choosing between studying abroad and staying in China, I prefer the former. Studying abroad exposes students to diverse cultures and broadens their horizons. Moreover, it cultivates independence and adaptability. That said, staying domestically also has its merits, such as lower costs and familiar surroundings.
examples.zh: 在出国留学和留在国内之间，我倾向于前者。留学让学生接触多元文化、开阔视野。此外，它还培养独立性和适应力。话虽如此，留在国内也有其优势，如较低的费用和熟悉的环境。
examples.analysis:
场景⑤ 比较选择（A vs B）
论点: 表明倾向(the former)
论据: 理由1(多元文化) + 理由2(独立适应)
论证: 让步补充(domestic merits)

steps.label: 论点
steps.detail: 表明倾向(I prefer the former)

steps.label: 论据
steps.detail: 理由1(diverse cultures) + 理由2(independence)

steps.label: 论证
steps.detail: 让步补充(That said...merits)

examples.en: I think online learning is good. Many people use it. It is convenient and you can study at home. So online learning is very important.
examples.zh: 我觉得线上学习很好。很多人都用它。它很方便，可以在家学。所以线上学习非常重要。
examples.analysis: 典型错误：无论点句（没有表明是哪类场景）、无连接词串联（First/Second/However 缺失）、论证靠重复而不是具体论据。正确做法应先判断场景（如②现象原因），用归因句式展开两层原因，再收束影响。

steps.label: 错误诊断
steps.detail: 无场景分类意识，堆砌观点不展开

steps.label: 对比修正
steps.detail: 改为场景②: 现象(The surge in online learning) → 归因(First...Second...) → 论证(This trend is here to stay)

examples.en: Everyone should study hard. If you don't study, you will fail. Studying is the most important thing for students. Therefore, we must study hard every day.
examples.zh: 每个人都应该努力学习。如果你不学习，你就会失败。学习对学生来说是最重要的事。所以我们每天都必须努力学习。
examples.analysis: 典型错误：全段空喊口号，缺少具体论据支撑（没有数据、实例或逻辑推理）。正确做法应选场景④建议方案：指出问题(成绩下滑现象) → 提出方案(制定计划/寻求辅导) → 预期效果(提升成绩)。

steps.label: 错误诊断
steps.detail: 空泛观点 + 循环论证，无实质论据

steps.label: 对比修正
steps.detail: 改为场景④: 问题(成绩下滑) → 方案(制定学习计划 + 寻求辅导) → 效果(显著提升)

config.title: 场景识别练
config.stem: 题目：'Some people think technology makes life easier, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion.' 这道题的主体段应使用哪个场景公式？

options.text: 场景① 观点表态（让步驳论）
场景② 现象原因（归因分析）
场景③ 利弊权衡（双面论证）
场景⑤ 比较选择（A vs B）

config.explanation: 题目要求 Discuss both views and give your opinion，典型的双面论证场景：先展开优点、再转折缺点、最后综合评判。

config.title: 场景②模板填空·话题: 大学生兼职
config.stem: The phenomenon of college students taking part-time jobs has become increasingly prevalent. {{1}} can be attributed to several factors. First, students seek to {{2}} beyond their parents' support. Second, part-time work provides {{3}} that may not be available in the classroom. This trend, if managed properly, can {{4}} their overall career readiness.
config.explanation: 场景②归因分析模板：先提出现象(The phenomenon)，用 can be attributed to 归因，First/Second 分层展开原因，最后 This trend 收束影响。填入的每个空都是该场景的高分短语，记住归因句式和连接词搭配。

config.title: 场景③模板填空·话题: 社交媒体对青少年的影响
config.stem: Social media has both positive and negative effects on teenagers. On the one hand, it {{1}} with friends and access to diverse information. On the other hand, excessive use may {{2}} and lead to anxiety. {{3}}, a balanced approach with parental guidance can help teenagers {{4}} the benefits while minimizing the drawbacks.
config.explanation: 场景③利弊权衡模板：On the one hand 展开优点，On the other hand 转折缺点，最后用 On balance 综合评判。注意利弊权衡的关键是转折连接词和综合评判的收束句式，不要只罗列优缺点而缺少最终立场。

config.title: 简版改写: 场景①让步驳论
config.source: Some people think online shopping is bad because you can't see the real product. But I think online shopping is good because it is very convenient and saves time. You can buy things without leaving your house.
config.taskDescription: 将这段口语化表述改写为符合场景①让步驳论模板的主体段：用 Admittedly 让步 → However 转折反驳 → For instance 举例强化 → 收束论证
reference: Admittedly, online shopping carries the risk of receiving products that differ from their online descriptions. However, the convenience and time-saving benefits it offers far outweigh this drawback. For instance, consumers can compare prices across multiple platforms within minutes, which would take hours in physical stores. This efficiency makes online shopping an indispensable part of modern life.
rubric: 使用 Admittedly...However 让步转折结构
包含 For instance 举例论证
有收束句总结影响
主谓一致、无语法错误
config.explanation: 原段落问题：没有让步结构（直接表态 but I think）、论据过于口语化（can't see the real product）。改写要点：先承认对方观点（risk of receiving different products），再用 However 转折到核心论点，用 For instance 引出具体数据对比，最后收束。

config.title: 进阶改写: 场景④建议方案
config.source: Traffic congestion is a big problem in cities. The government should build more roads and encourage people to take buses. If everyone follows these rules, traffic will be better.
config.taskDescription: 改写为场景④建议方案主体段，要求：(1) 用高级词替换基础词（如 traffic congestion → gridlock / alleviate）；(2) 至少用 2 个连接词（Moreover / Furthermore / Additionally）；(3) 提出具体可行方案并收束预期效果
reference: Traffic congestion in major cities has reached an unbearable level. To alleviate this issue, municipal governments should invest in expanding public transit networks and implement congestion pricing during peak hours. Moreover, promoting remote work policies can significantly reduce commuter volume. If these measures are properly enforced, urban traffic flow would improve markedly within a few years, benefiting both residents and the environment.
rubric: 含高级词替换（alleviate / municipal / congestion pricing / markedly）
至少 2 个连接词（Moreover / Furthermore / Additionally / Additionally / In addition）
方案具体可执行（不是泛泛而谈）
有预期效果收束句
config.explanation: 原段落问题：用词平庸（big problem / build more roads）、方案笼统（take buses）、无连接词串联。进阶改写要用更精准的词汇描述问题（unbearable level），提出可量化的方案（congestion pricing / remote work），并用 Moreover 递进，最后用 If...would 虚拟语气收束效果。

config.text: 审题先分场景，主体段不慌：观点让步驳、现象归因析、利弊双面衡、方案解问题、比较选 A B！
takeaway: 5 大场景覆盖 90% 议论文主体段题型
每场景 = 论点 + 论据 + 论证 三件套
高分句式 Admittedly / Nevertheless / On balance 是加分利器
错例诊断：无场景意识、缺连接词、空喊口号是三大致命伤
填空练模板 → 改写练迁移，脚手架递减才扎实

card_shared_writing_scenario_openings.title: 议论文开头·5 大场景模板包

objectives: 按场景区分 5 类议论文题型：观点表态 / 现象原因 / 利弊权衡 / 建议方案 / 比较选择
记住每场景 2 套高分开头句式（共 10 套）
看到题目 5 秒判断场景 → 套对应模板

config.title: 审题 5 秒定模板
config.text: 四六级议论文题目千变万化，但归根结底只有 5 种场景。看懂场景，开头直接套公式，不用临场发挥。

config.title: 5 大场景 × 2 套模板
config.rule: 审题先判场景 → 选对应模板 → 填入话题词即可成文
config.formula: 场景判断（5s）→ 模板选择 → 话题词替换
bullets: ① 观点表态：题目直接问你 agree/disagree 或 your opinion → 模板 A: It is widely believed that... However, I firmly hold that... / 模板 B: When it comes to..., opinions vary. Personally, I am convinced that...

② 现象原因：题目描述现象问 why 或 analyze the reasons → 模板 A: ...has aroused wide concern. Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. / 模板 B: In recent years, ...has become increasingly prevalent. The reasons behind this trend are as follows.

③ 利弊权衡：题目问 advantages and disadvantages 或 discuss both sides → 模板 A: ...has sparked a heated debate. While some praise its benefits, others warn of its drawbacks. / 模板 B: The issue of whether... is beneficial has drawn divergent views. Both sides hold valid arguments.

④ 建议方案：题目问 how to solve 或 what measures → 模板 A: ...has posed a serious challenge. It is imperative that we take effective measures to address this issue. / 模板 B: Faced with the growing problem of..., joint efforts from all sectors are urgently needed.

⑤ 比较选择：题目给两个选项问 which do you prefer → 模板 A: When faced with the choice between... and..., I would prefer... without hesitation. / 模板 B: ...and... each have their merits. However, after careful consideration, I believe... is the better option.

examples.en: It is widely believed that university education is primarily about obtaining a degree. However, I firmly hold that its true value lies in cultivating critical thinking and independent judgment.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为大学教育主要是为了获得学位。然而，我坚信其真正价值在于培养批判性思维和独立判断能力。
examples.question: 这个开头属于哪种场景？
examples.analysis: 题目问 opinion / agree → 观点表态场景。It is widely believed that... 引出普遍看法，However 转折亮出自己的立场。

steps.detail: It is widely believed that university education is primarily about obtaining a degree.

steps.label: 表双方

examples.en: In recent years, the phenomenon of young people choosing to work in big cities rather than their hometowns has become increasingly prevalent. The reasons behind this trend are multifaceted and worth exploring.

examples.question: 这个开头属于哪种场景？
examples.analysis: 题目描述现象问 why → 现象原因场景。In recent years 引出背景现象，后句过渡到原因分析。

steps.label: 引话题
steps.detail: In recent years, the phenomenon of young people choosing to work in big cities...

config.title: 开头常见错例·对比辨析

examples.en: Nowadays, online learning is very popular. Many students like it. I think it is good.
examples.zh: 如今，在线学习很流行。很多学生喜欢它。我觉得它很好。
examples.analysis: 本例错在：① 开头三句全是短句，没有模板结构；② 观点表态场景却用了 Nowdays 引出现象（场景错位）；③ 词汇口语化（very popular / I think it is good），不符合四六级书面语要求。应改为：It is widely believed that online learning offers unparalleled convenience. However, I firmly hold that its effectiveness largely depends on students' self-discipline and time management skills.

steps.label: 引话题
steps.detail: 错：Nowadays 引出现象，适合现象原因场景而非观点表态

steps.label: 表双方
steps.detail: 缺：没有呈现对立观点（Many students like it 太笼统）

steps.label: 立场
steps.detail: 错：I think it is good 太口语化，无论据支撑

config.title: 场景判断·5 秒速判
config.stem:
请判断以下题目属于哪种议论文场景：

"Some people think social media has more negative effects on teenagers than positive ones. Discuss both views and give your own opinion."

options.text: 观点表态（直接表态 agree/disagree）
利弊权衡（discuss both sides / advantages and disadvantages）
建议方案（how to solve / measures）
比较选择（which do you prefer / A or B）

config.explanation: 题目出现 "Discuss both views"，明确要求讨论正反两面，属于利弊权衡场景。应使用 "...has sparked a heated debate. While some praise its benefits, others warn of its drawbacks." 等模板开头。

config.title: 模板填空·话题 1: 在线教育
config.stem: In recent years, {{1}} has become a widely discussed topic. Some people argue that it offers unprecedented convenience, while others contend that it lacks the interpersonal interaction of traditional classrooms. From my perspective, I am convinced that {{2}} will play an increasingly important role in modern education.
config.explanation: 话题 1 属于观点表态场景：In recent years 引出话题，Some... while others... 呈现双方观点，From my perspective 亮出自己立场。填入话题词 online learning 即可完成开头段。

config.title: 模板填空·话题 2: 城市化
config.stem: The issue of whether {{1}} is beneficial has drawn divergent views. Some people maintain that it brings economic prosperity and career opportunities, whereas others worry about environmental degradation and rising living costs. After careful consideration, I believe the advantages of {{2}} outweigh its drawbacks.
config.explanation: 话题 2 属于利弊权衡场景：The issue of whether... is beneficial 标志性开头，Some... whereas others... 正反对比，After careful consideration 引出权衡后的立场。换话题词训练模板迁移能力。

config.title: 基础改写·套用模板
config.source: I think college students should study abroad. It can help them learn new things and see different cultures. Many people agree with me.
config.taskDescription: 将这段口语化的开头改写为符合「观点表态」模板的正式学术开头，使用 It is widely believed that... However, I firmly hold that... 结构。
reference: It is widely believed that studying abroad merely broadens one's horizons. However, I firmly hold that it fundamentally transforms students' perspectives by exposing them to diverse cultures and academic traditions.
rubric: 使用模板结构（引出普遍观点 + 转折亮立场）
词汇升级（I think → I firmly hold; learn new things → transforms perspectives）
立场明确，有论据支撑
config.explanation: 原句口语化且缺乏模板结构。改写时需：① 用 It is widely believed that 替代 I think / Many people agree；② 用 However, I firmly hold that 转折亮出立场；③ 词汇从口语升级为书面语。

config.title: 进阶改写·连接词 + 高级词
config.source: Nowadays, many people worry about air pollution. Air pollution is getting worse. We need to do something about it.
config.taskDescription: 将这段平庸开头改写为「建议方案」场景的正式开头。要求：① 使用建议方案模板；② 至少含 1 个连接词（however / moreover / furthermore / consequently）；③ 至少 1 个高级词替换（如 posed a serious challenge / imperative / address / joint efforts）。
reference: Air pollution has posed a serious challenge to public health and environmental sustainability. It is imperative that governments, corporations, and individuals take coordinated measures to address this pressing issue before its consequences become irreversible.
rubric: 使用建议方案模板（描述问题 + 呼吁行动）
含至少 1 个连接词（imperative / consequently / furthermore）
至少 1 个高级词替换（posed a serious challenge / irreversible / sustainability）
立场明确，语气正式
config.explanation: 原句三个短句无模板结构且用词平庸。进阶改写要点：① 套用建议方案模板（...has posed a serious challenge. It is imperative that...）；② 连接词提升逻辑衔接（imperative / consequently）；③ 高级词替换增强书面感（worry about → posed a serious challenge; do something → take coordinated measures）。

config.title: 速记口诀
config.text: 五场景五公式，审题五秒定开头
takeaway: 观点表态：It is widely believed... However, I hold that...
现象原因：In recent years... The reasons are...
利弊权衡：...sparked a heated debate. While... others...
建议方案：...posed a serious challenge. It is imperative that...
比较选择：When faced with the choice between... I prefer...

objectives: 按功能分类记忆衔接词：递进 / 转折 / 因果 / 列举 / 总结
通过卡片翻面巩固高频衔接词
选择题练习衔接词上下文匹配

config.text: 阅卷老师平均每篇作文只看 30 秒，衔接词是让你逻辑'一秒可见'的秘密武器

config.title: 衔接词五大功能分类
config.rule: 议论文衔接词按功能分为递进、转折、因果、列举、总结五类，每类背 3-5 个高频词即可覆盖 90% 场景
config.formula: 议论文逻辑链 = 引出话题 + 递进/转折/因果展开 + 列举举例 + 总结收尾
bullets: 递进：moreover / furthermore / in addition
转折：however / nevertheless / on the contrary
因果：therefore / consequently / as a result
列举：firstly / for instance / specifically
总结：in conclusion / to sum up / overall

config.title: 正例：衔接词串联的议论文段落

examples.en: Online education has become increasingly popular. Moreover, it offers flexible schedules for working adults. However, some argue that it lacks face-to-face interaction. For instance, students may feel isolated without classroom discussions. Therefore, a blended approach combining online and offline learning is recommended.
examples.zh: 在线教育越来越受欢迎。此外，它为在职成人提供了灵活的时间安排。然而，有人认为它缺乏面对面互动。例如，学生如果没有课堂讨论可能会感到孤立。因此，建议采用线上线下结合的混合学习方式。

steps.label: 引话题
steps.detail: Online education has become increasingly popular — 话题引入句

steps.label: 递进展开
steps.detail: Moreover... — 补充正面论据

steps.label: 转折对比
steps.detail: However... — 引出反面观点

steps.label: 举例佐证
steps.detail: For instance... — 具体例证

steps.label: 总结立场
steps.detail: Therefore... — 得出结论

config.title: 反例：衔接词缺失或误用

examples.en: Online education is popular. It is flexible. Some people don't like it. Students feel lonely. We should combine online and offline learning.
examples.zh: 在线教育很流行。它很灵活。有些人不喜欢它。学生感到孤独。我们应该把线上和线下学习结合起来。
examples.analysis: 本例错在：① 缺少衔接词，句与句之间没有逻辑连接，读起来像流水账；② 观点之间无转折/递进标记，读者无法判断作者立场是支持还是反对；③ 结论突然出现，缺乏 therefore / in conclusion 等总结信号词。应改为：加入 moreover / however / for instance / therefore 等功能各异的衔接词，让逻辑链清晰可见。

example.en: The plan is feasible; moreover, it is cost-effective.
example.zh: 该计划可行；此外，它还具有成本效益。

example.en: The task was difficult; nevertheless, they completed it on time.
example.zh: 任务很困难；然而他们还是按时完成了。

example.en: He ignored the warning; consequently, he failed the exam.
example.zh: 他忽视了警告；因此考试没通过。

example.en: Many factors contributed to the success, specifically teamwork and dedication.
example.zh: 许多因素促成了成功，具体来说是团队合作和奉献精神。

example.en: In conclusion, education plays a vital role in personal development.
example.zh: 总之，教育在个人发展中起着至关重要的作用。

config.title: 衔接词语境匹配
config.stem: ___, regular exercise can improve mental health. Which transition word best fits?
config.explanation: 前句与后句为递进关系，moreover 表示'此外'，用于补充论据。however 表转折，in conclusion 表总结，for instance 表举例，均不符合语境。

config.title: 模板填空 · 话题 1：教育
config.stem: Some people believe that {{1}} is the key to success. {{2}}, it helps develop critical thinking skills. {{3}}, others argue that practical experience is more important. {{4}}, a balance between theory and practice should be pursued.
config.explanation: 第一空填话题名词 education；第二空用递进词 moreover 补充正面论据；第三空用转折词 however 引出反方观点；第四空用总结词 therefore 收束段落。四个空覆盖递进—转折—总结三种功能。

config.title: 模板填空 · 话题 2：科技
config.stem: Technology has transformed the way we live. {{1}}, smartphones allow us to access information instantly. {{2}}, excessive screen time may harm our health. {{3}}, spending too much time on social media can lead to anxiety. {{4}}, we should use technology wisely and set healthy boundaries.
config.explanation: 第一空用列举词 for instance 给出正面例证；第二空用转折词 however 引出负面影响；第三空用 specifically 深入展开反面论据；第四空用 therefore 总结立场。同模板换话题强化衔接词的迁移运用能力。

config.title: 基础改写：加入衔接词
config.source: Learning a foreign language is useful. It improves memory. It helps with career development. Some people think it is a waste of time. We should encourage language learning in schools.
config.taskDescription: 在每句话之间加入合适的衔接词（递进 / 转折 / 因果 / 列举 / 总结），使段落逻辑连贯。至少使用 3 个不同功能的衔接词。
reference: Learning a foreign language is useful. Moreover, it improves memory. Furthermore, it helps with career development. However, some people think it is a waste of time. Therefore, we should encourage language learning in schools.
rubric: 至少 3 个不同功能的衔接词
衔接词位置正确（句首或分号后）
逻辑链完整：递进→转折→因果

config.title: 进阶改写：升级衔接词 + 复杂句
config.source: Learning a foreign language is useful. Moreover, it improves memory. Furthermore, it helps with career development. However, some people think it is a waste of time. Therefore, we should encourage language learning in schools.
config.taskDescription: 进阶要求：① 将至少 1 个基础衔接词替换为高级同义词（如 moreover→additionally, however→nevertheless）；② 将至少 2 个简单句合并为复合句（使用 although / because / while 等从属连词）。
reference: Learning a foreign language is undeniably useful. Additionally, it has been shown to improve memory and cognitive function. Nevertheless, some argue that it is a waste of time, claiming that English alone is sufficient. While this view is understandable, we should still encourage language learning in schools, as it broadens career opportunities and cultural understanding.
rubric: 至少 1 个高级衔接词替换（如 additionally/nevertheless/indeed）
至少 2 个复合句（含 although/because/while 等）
衔接词位置正确，逻辑链完整
立场明确，首尾呼应

config.text: 五类衔接词，每类背 3-5 个，议论文逻辑连贯拿高分
takeaway: 递进 moreover / furthermore 补充论点
转折 however / nevertheless 引出对比
因果 therefore / consequently 表结果
列举 firstly / for instance 给例子
总结 in conclusion / to sum up 收尾

card_shared_writing_universal_sentences.title: 四六级作文万能句：7 个功能位速用

objectives: 掌握开头、原因、举例、对比、转折、总结、观点 7 类万能句的使用位置
学会把模板里的省略号替换成具体话题和观点
避免堆砌套话，让万能句服务于文章逻辑

config.title: 万能句不是背完就会用
config.text: 作文模板真正有用的地方，不是整段照抄，而是在该转折、该举例、该总结的位置，快速拿出一句自然的表达。

config.title: 万能句三步用法
config.rule: 先判断句子功能，再替换话题词，最后检查它是否承接上下文。
config.formula: 功能位 → 话题替换 → 逻辑检查
bullets: 开头句：用于引出话题，适合第一段第一句，不要连续堆 3 句背景。
原因句：用于主体段展开，后面必须接具体原因，不能只写 Firstly / Secondly。
举例句：用于把抽象观点落地，例子要和主题同向。
对比 / 转折句：用于呈现另一面，常和 however / while / although 搭配。
总结 / 观点句：用于收束全文或亮明态度，避免和前文立场矛盾。

config.title: 7 类万能句怎么放进作文

examples.en: In recent years, the topic of online learning has been brought into focus and has been widely discussed.
examples.zh: 近年来，在线学习这一话题成为焦点并被广泛讨论。
examples.question: 功能位
examples.analysis: 把原句中的 topic of ... 替换成具体话题即可。适合议论文、说明文第一段，但后面要接观点或写作方向。

steps.label: 模板
steps.detail: In recent years, the topic of ... has been brought into focus and has been widely discussed.

steps.label: 替换
steps.detail: ... = online learning / mobile payment / environmental protection

steps.label: 接下句
steps.detail: 议论文接 In my opinion...；说明文接 This essay will explain...

examples.en: There are several reasons accounting for this phenomenon. Firstly, flexible schedules make online learning convenient. Secondly, digital resources allow students to review lessons repeatedly.
examples.zh: 有几个原因可以解释这一现象。首先，灵活的时间安排使在线学习更加方便。其次，数字资源让学生能够反复复习课程。
examples.question: 功能位
examples.analysis: 原因句后面必须接具体内容。只写 There are several reasons... 而不展开，会显得空。

steps.label: 模板
steps.detail: There are several reasons accounting for this phenomenon.

steps.label: 展开
steps.detail: Firstly 后写原因 1，Secondly 后写原因 2。

steps.label: 检查
steps.detail: 每个原因都要能回答 why。

examples.en: However, the situation is not as simple as it seems. Although mobile payment brings convenience, it may also lead to overspending.
examples.zh: 然而，情况并不像看起来那么简单。虽然移动支付带来了便利，但它也可能导致过度消费。
examples.question: 功能位
examples.analysis: 转折句适合放在承认优点之后，引出限制或问题。它能让文章更平衡，避免只写单方面观点。

题目：Should college students take part-time jobs?

config.title: 改写练习：去掉生硬堆砌
config.source: Nowadays, with the rapid development of society and technology, online learning is important. In recent years, the topic of online learning has been widely discussed. It is commonly acknowledged that online learning plays a significant role in our daily life. From my perspective, online learning is good.
config.taskDescription: 这段开头连续堆了 3 个背景万能句，显得重复。请改写成 2-3 句：保留话题引入、明确观点，并自然过渡到主体段。

rubric: 只保留 1 个背景引入句，避免重复
有清晰观点，如 I believe / From my perspective
能自然引出后文原因或主体段

句子自然，不机械堆模板

config.title: 本卡口诀
config.text: 万能句要按功能位使用：开头引题，主体讲因例转，结尾观点再收束。
takeaway: 开头句只选 1 句，后面必须接观点或写作方向。
原因句、举例句、对比句要服务主体段，不要孤零零出现。
转折句用于补充另一面，让文章更平衡。
总结句要回扣观点，不要突然提出新话题。
模板里的省略号必须换成具体话题、原因和行动。
